2）广度优先探索（Algorithm 1）：维护"已访问页面+动作轨迹"队列，从首页种子开始；对每个页面用 LLM 发现简单任务集合 S_init，剔除冗余/危险/不重要任务（登录登出、账号创建修改、支付、广告弹窗、tooltip 等），再并入信息检索型任务 S_in；用 LLM 将元素划分为固定集 S_f 与动态集 S_d，固定任务全量执行、动态任务仅采样代表性子集 S_dsamp（避免冗余探索）；执行每个简单任务后若到达新页面则入队（保留 trace），若仍是同一页面但出现"中等程度视觉变化"（LLM 判定，通常意味着菜单/下拉被展开），则从新增可见元素中发现新任务 S_new 并递归展开，形成层级；最后删除仅展开用的中间任务、保留叶子任务并重建祖先动作前缀（如"click 用户名 → click 设置"）。
3）跨页知识传播：队列把先前页面已发现的任务传给后续页面，避免同站重复功能（如各页面的搜索框）被反复发现。
4）复杂任务合成：动作型任务沿用 OS-Genesis 提示，在观测到≥3 个逻辑连贯动作时合成，并用其任务评估器打 1–5 分，仅保留≥3 分者；同时记录对应 action trace；信息检索型任务在每个页面按 0–2 条生成并同样评分筛选，形成 T_ex。
5）轨迹精化（2.3）：用 SynthAgent 的网页智能体，以探索轨迹作为额外"提示"（hint）作为 LLM 推理之外的接地依据，同时改写任务描述并生成真实轨迹 t_ref = f_wa(t_ex)；判定失败或超过 30 步未完成则丢弃。
6）SFT 构造与微调（2.4）：将每个观测-动作对序列化为 ShareGPT 对话（用户侧含任务描述、截图、无障碍树、最近 3 个历史动作；助手侧含下一动作及推理），末观测配终止动作；用与 SynthAgent 相同的超参微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct；探索/任务合成/精化均使用 GPT-4.1。
7）评估设置：WebArena，排除 Wikipedia（需跨站导航）与 Maps（环境故障），每模板取 1 个任务，得 CMS 57、Gitlab 56、Reddit 26、Shopping 55 题；两种设置：单站微调 AutoSurfer_wllm 与四站合并 AutoSurfer_webarena。

Result: 主结果（WebArena 整体完成率）：GPT-4.1 基线 25.77%；Qwen2.5 原始基线 9.36%；Explorer 4.64%；OS-Genesis 13.40%；SynthAgent 19.59%；AutoSurfer_wllm 23.71%；AutoSurfer_webarena 24.23%（最佳，为 +4.64 绝对提升）。分站点看，Reddit 上 AutoSurfer_wllm 达 34.62%，远高于 SynthAgent 的 15.38%；CMS 22.81% vs 21.05%；Shopping 23.64% vs 20.00%；Gitlab 19.64% 与 SynthAgent 持平。wllm 与 webarena 两版接近，说明单站数据已足以建模整站能力。作者强调 GPT-4.1 未直接对比，因模型规模远大于 Qwen2.5，仅作上限参考。
其他实验：（1）换模型验证——用相同 Reddit 数据微调 Qwen3-VL-8B，原模型 3.85% → 微调后 30.77%，与 Qwen2.5 上的增益趋势一致，说明更强基座同样缺乏高质量网页交互数据；（2）任务多样性——用 text-3-large-large 嵌入任务标题并计算归一化平均成对余弦相似度再取补，AutoSurfer 0.7774 最高，OS-Genesis 与 SynthAgent 均为 0.7459（Explorer 因每站平均不足 2 个任务被剔除）；（3）消融精化阶段——Reddit 上仅用探索数据训练为 11.54%，精化数据为 34.62%，原因在于探索阶段动作空间受限（如不滚动、动态列表只抽样）导致监督不完整，而精化阶段以任务为中心可用完整动作空间（含滚动）并删除冗余动作（如"查看帖子的全部评论"任务中被裁剪为仅搜索+分析）。
作者说明总体准确率偏低是因刻意采用较简单的 SynthAgent 式 LLM 网页智能体，以便隔离数据/模型质量的贡献而非依赖更强 agent 框架。

Conclusion: AutoSurfer 通过"系统性 BFS 探索 + 轨迹引导的任务合成 + 轨迹引导的轨迹精化"三项耦合设计，显著提升网页覆盖度与任务-轨迹一致性，生成的 SFT 数据可训练出网站专属模型（wLLM），在 WebArena 上以 24.23% 的整体完成率超越 Explorer/OS-Genesis/SynthAgent，并带来最高的任务多样性；探索数据与精化数据的差距（11.54% vs 34.62%）证明精化阶段不可或缺。作者认为 AutoSurfer 是首个明确为训练 wLLM 而设计的工作。局限包括：依赖 GPT-4.1 做数据生成成本高、整体绝对准确率仍低于 GPT-4.1 上限、跨站/多跳长程任务未覆盖、Qwen3 实验仅在 Reddit 单站小规模进行。未来方向是以精化轨迹作为强化学习的初始化，配合在线交互与任务完成奖励，以适应更长程及跨网站任务，突破静态 SFT 的局限。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized web agents that can automate complex tasks on websites. However, their accuracy remains limited by the scarcity of high-quality web trajectory training data. Existing automatic trajectory generation methods suffer from incomplete website coverage due to homepage-based task proposals or random-walk exploration. Such methods often result in hallucinated or ambiguous task synthesis that lead to incomplete and unreliable trajectory generation. Here, we present AutoSurfer, a comprehensive web trajectory generator that addresses these limitations through three key innovations. First, AutoSurfer employs a systematic breadth-first exploration strategy that maintains a queue of discovered pages and action traces, propagates knowledge across pages to avoid redundant exploration, and recursively expands multi-level graphical user interface elements - closely resembling how a human would learn a new website. Second, AutoSurfer leverages the exploration trajectory to guide task synthesis, reducing hallucinations by grounding complex tasks in actual navigation paths rather than isolated actions or page content alone. Third, AutoSurfer uses the same exploration trajectory as hints to steer a web agent toward more accurate and reliable trajectory refinement. Together, these innovations enable AutoSurfer to comprehensively cover a website's action space and generate data suitable for training website-specific LLMs. We evaluate AutoSurfer on the WebArena benchmark by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and demonstrate that it outperforms state-of-the-art methods - Explorer, OS-Genesis, and SynthAgent - achieving up to 24.23% overall task completion accuracy compared to 19.59% for the best prior method. Further, task diversity analysis demonstrates that AutoSurfer yields a more diverse distribution of synthesized tasks.

</details>


### [167] [OptimusKG: Unifying biomedical knowledge in a modern multimodal graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27269)
*Lucas Vittor,Ayush Noori,Iñaki Arango,Joaquín Polonuer,Sam Rodriques,Andrew White,David A. Clifton,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OptimusKG是一个整合18个本体资源的生物医学知识图谱，包含约19万节点和2181万边，通过文献证据验证了图的可靠性，可用于图机器学习和大型语言模型知识检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生物医学知识图谱存在两个主要问题：从非结构化文档衍生的图缺乏模式级约束，而从结构化资源组装的图难以统一协调。

Method: 构建了一个多模态生物医学标记属性图（LPG），整合结构化和半结构化资源，跨分子、解剖、临床和环境领域保留事实性、类型特定元数据，并通过多模态agent PaperQA3验证图中关系的科学文献证据支持情况。

Result: OptimusKG包含190,531个节点（10种实体类型）、21,813,816条边（26种关系类型）、67,249,863个属性实例（150种属性键编码110,276,843个值），来自18个本体和控制词表。验证显示70.0%的采样边获得文献支持，83.4%的采样假边无文献支持。

Conclusion: OptimusKG可作为图机器学习、大语言模型知识检索和生物医学发现（如假设生成）的标准化资源，Apache Parquet格式分发。部分边缺乏文献支持可能反映了实验和功能基因组学资源中的知识先于科学文献综合的特点。

Abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) are widely used in the life sciences, yet many are derived from unstructured documents and therefore lack schema-level constrains, whereas graphs assembled from structured resources are difficult to harmonize into a unified representation. We present OptimusKG, a multimodal biomedical labeled property graph (LPG) built from structured and semi-structured resources to preserve factual, type-specific metadata across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains. OptimusKG contains 190,531 nodes across 10 entity types, 21,813,816 edges across 26 relation types, and 67,249,863 property instances encoding 110,276,843 values across 150 distinct property keys, derived from 18 ontologies and controlled vocabularies. The graph enforces a top-level schema for nodes and edges and retains granular, type-specific properties, cross-references, and provenance across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains. We assessed the validity of OptimusKG by evaluating whether graph relationships are supported by evidence from the scientific literature using a multimodal agent, PaperQA3. PaperQA3 identified supporting evidence for 70.0% of sampled edges, whereas 83.4% of sampled false edges received no supporting evidence. Edges without literature support were concentrated in associations derived from experimental and functional genomics resources, suggesting that OptimusKG captures biomedical knowledge that may precede synthesis in the scientific literature. OptimusKG is distributed as Apache Parquet files, providing a standardized resource for graph-based machine learning, knowledge-grounded retrieval with large language models, and biomedical discovery use cases such as hypothesis generation.

</details>


### [168] [The Inverse-Wisdom Law: Architectural Tribalism and the Consensus Paradox in Agentic Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27274)
*Dahlia Shehata,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper challenges the assumption that AI multi-agent systems benefit from "Wisdom of the Crowd" by formalizing the Consensus Paradox. Through extensive experiments across SOTA benchmarks, the authors prove the Inverse-Wisdom Law: adding more logical agents to kinship-dominant swarms stabilizes errors rather than improving truth accuracy. They identify the Tribalism Coefficient and Sycophantic Weight as key mechanistic determinants of swarm failure, and propose the Heterogeneity Mandate as a safety requirement for resilient agentic architectures.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current research paradigms assume agent collaboration mirrors the "Wisdom of the Crowd." This paper challenges this axiomatic assumption by identifying a fundamental flaw in multi-agent systems: agentic swarms may prioritize internal architectural agreement over external logical truth.

Method: The paper conducted 36 experiments encompassing 12,804 trajectories across three SOTA benchmarks (GAIA, Multi-Challenge, SWE-bench), evaluating interactions between three leading models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4). The study formalized the Consensus Paradox and proved the Inverse-Wisdom Law through systematic evaluation of kinship-dominant swarms.

Result: The study established the Inverse-Wisdom Law: in kinship-dominant swarms, adding logical agents increases the stability of erroneous trajectories rather than the probability of truth. Additional logical audits lead to Logic Saturation where internal entropy hits zero while factual error hits unity. The Architectural Tribalism Asymmetry was identified as a mechanistic law of transformer weights.

Conclusion: The paper concludes that swarm integrity is gated by the synthesizer's receptive logic rather than aggregate agent quality. It proposes the Tribalism Coefficient and Sycophantic Weight as mechanistic determinants of swarm failure, and establishes the Heterogeneity Mandate as a foundational safety requirement for resilient agentic architectures.

Abstract: As AI transitions toward multi-agent systems (MAS) to solve complex workflows, research paradigms operate on the axiomatic assumption that agent collaboration mirrors the "Wisdom of the Crowd". We challenge this assumption by formalizing the Consensus Paradox: a phenomenon where agentic swarms prioritize internal architectural agreement over external logical truth. Through a 36 experiments encompassing 12,804 trajectories across three state-of-the-art (SOTA) benchmarks (GAIA, Multi-Challenge, and SWE-bench), we prove the Inverse-Wisdom Law: in kinship-dominant swarms, adding logical agents increases the stability of erroneous trajectories rather than the probability of truth. The introduction of additional logical audits converges the system toward a Logic Saturation where internal entropy hits zero while factual error hits unity. By evaluating the interaction between the 3 preeminent SOTA models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.4), we establish the Architectural Tribalism Asymmetry as a mechanistic law of transformer weights. We demonstrate that terminal swarm integrity is strictly gated by the synthesizer's receptive logic, rather than aggregate agent quality. We define the Tribalism Coefficient and the Sycophantic Weight as the primary mechanistic determinants of swarm failure. Finally, we establish the Heterogeneity Mandate as a foundational safety requirement for resilient agentic architectures.

</details>


### [169] [Mechanized Foundations of Structural Governance: Machine-Checked Proofs for Governed Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27289)
*Alan L. McCann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出了一套认知工作流系统结构治理的形式化理论，包含三个机械化定理（Coinductive Safety Predicate、Governance Invariance Theorem、Sufficiency Theorem）、两个纸面证明（Alternating Normal Form、Necessity Theorem），以及一个连接抽象模型与BEAM运行时的大规模验证系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知工作流系统需要可证明的安全治理机制。文章旨在回答三个核心问题：如何形式化定义治理安全性？治理是否在不同元递归层次间保持一致性？已有的原子原语集合是否足以表达任意离散智能系统？

Method: 形式化方法（Coq/Interaction Trees库）+ 参数化余归纳法；显式归约证明（Rice定理归约）；属性测试（70,000随机指令序列）；组合闭包（Kleisli范畴）；可结合归约系统。

Result: 提出了六项贡献：①定义了coinductive safety predicate（gov_safe）；②证明了governance invariance theorem；③证明了sufficiency theorem（四原子原语具有表达完全性）；④建立了alternating normal form；⑤通过归约到Rice定理证明了reason原语的必要性；⑥形式化验证了BEAM运行时的信任、能力与哈希链逻辑，并通过70,000次随机测试确认零分歧。

Conclusion: 研究建立了认知工作流系统治理的形式化理论框架，涵盖安全性、可表达性、范式化表达和必要性等多个维度。Coq机械化证明了三个关键定理，纸面证明了两个核心结论，并通过大规模属性测试验证了形式化规范与实际运行时的一致性。12,000行Coq代码、36个模块、454条定理、零承认引理构成了一个高度可信的形式化验证工作。第六项贡献——verified interpreter specification——将抽象理论模型与BEAM运行时实现连接起来，是理论走向工程实践的关键桥梁。

Abstract: We present five results in the theory of structural governance for cognitive workflow systems. Three are mechanized in Coq 8.19 using the Interaction Trees library with parameterized coinduction; two are proved on paper with explicit reductions. The Coinductive Safety Predicate (gov_safe) is a coinductive property that captures governance safety for infinite program behaviors, indexed by a boolean permission flag that is provably false for ungoverned I/O and true for governed interpretations (mechanized). The Governance Invariance Theorem establishes that governance is uniform across the meta-recursive tower: governance at level n+1 reduces to governance at level n by definitional equality of the type (mechanized). The Sufficiency Theorem proves that four atomic primitives (code, reason, memory, call) are expressively complete for any discrete intelligent system, formalized as compositional closure of a Kleisli category (mechanized). The Alternating Normal Form provides a canonical decomposition of any machine into alternating code and effect layers, with a confluent rewriting system (paper proof). The Necessity Theorem proves via explicit reduction to Rice's theorem that an architecturally opaque component (the reason primitive) is mathematically necessary for problems requiring semantic judgment (paper proof). A sixth contribution connects the abstract model to the deployed runtime: the Verified Interpreter Specification formalizes the BEAM runtime's trust, capability, and hash chain logic in Coq, then tests the running system against this specification using property-based testing with over 70,000 randomly generated directive sequences and zero disagreements. The mechanization comprises approximately 12,000 lines across 36 modules with 454 theorems and zero admitted lemmas.

</details>


### [170] [The Two Boundaries: Why Behavioral AI Governance Fails Structurally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27292)
*Alan L. McCann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文证明AI系统的表达边界与治理边界之间的差距是不可判定的（基于Rice定理），提出"共限治理"概念——要求架构上将计算与效应分离，使治理成为执行管道的一部分而非外部系统。形式化证明在Coq中完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: In nearly all deployed AI systems, expressiveness boundaries (what systems can do) and governance boundaries (what governance covers) are defined independently, creating three problematic regions: governed capabilities (useful), ungoverned capabilities (risk), and governance theater (addressing non-existent capabilities). Two of three regions are failure modes.

Method: Applies Rice's theorem (1953) to prove the governance-expressiveness gap is undecidable in the general case for any Turing-complete architecture. Defines coterminous governance (where expressiveness boundary equals governance boundary) and shows it requires architectural separation of computation from effect rather than an added governance layer.

Result: Coterminous governance requires architectural separation of computation from effect—governance becomes part of the execution pipeline rather than a parallel system. Structural governance under this separation subsumes separate governance infrastructure.

Conclusion: Coterminous governance is proposed as the testable criterion: either the two boundaries are provably identical, or risk and theater are structurally inevitable. Formal proofs mechanized in Coq (454 theorems, 36 modules, 0 admitted).

Abstract: Every system that performs effects has two boundaries: what it can do (expressiveness) and what governance covers (governance). In nearly all deployed AI systems, these boundaries are defined independently, creating three regions: governed capabilities (the only useful region), ungoverned capabilities (risk), and governance policies that address non-existent capabilities (theater). Two of the three regions are failure modes. We focus on the governance of effects: actions that AI systems perform in the world (API calls, database writes, tool invocations). This is distinct from the governance of model outputs (content quality, bias, fairness), which operates at a different level and requires different mechanisms. We present a formal framework for analyzing this structural gap. Rice's theorem (1953) proves the gap is undecidable in the general case for any Turing-complete architecture that attempts to govern effects behaviorally: no algorithm can decide non-trivial semantic properties of arbitrary programs, including the property "this program's effects comply with the governance policy." We define coterminous governance: a system property where the expressivenessboundary equals the governance boundary. We show that coterminous governance requires an architectural decision (separatingcomputation from effect) rather than a governance layer added after the fact. We show that structural governance under this separation subsumes separate governance infrastructure: governance checks become part of the execution pipeline rather than a second system running alongside it. We propose coterminous governance as the testable criterion for any AI governance system: either the two boundaries are provably identical, or risk and theater are structurally inevitable. Proofs are mechanized in Coq (454 theorems, 36 modules, 0 admitted).

</details>


### [171] [Learning Rate Engineering: From Coarse Single Parameter to Layered Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27295)
*Ming-Hong Yao,Di Wang,Jian Cui,Jin-Yan Chen,Zi-Hao Cui,Fa Wang,Chen Wei,Qiu-Ye Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将学习率调度发展归纳为五代演进历程，针对迁移学习中的层级差异化需求，提出统一框架DALS。实验表明：DALS在合成任务上达到98.0%最佳准确率，且避免了在from-scratch和fine-tuning任务上的极端表现差异，验证了层级-时间联合调度策略的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习率调度从单一全局固定值发展到复杂的层级自适应策略。核心驱动力是解决迁移学习中的"不可能三角"：底层需要小更新以保留预训练获得的通用知识，而高层需要大更新以适应新任务。从"一刀切"策略转向按层级和时间定制的调度方案。

Method: 提出DALS(判别性自适应层缩放)统一框架，整合三种机制：1)相位自适应余弦调度(phase-adaptive cosine scheduling)；2)深度感知的Grokfast梯度滤波(depth-aware Grokfast gradient filtering)；3)LARS风格的信任比率(LARS-style trust ratios)。该框架针对迁移学习的"不可能三角"问题——底层需小更新保持通用知识，顶层需大更新适应新任务。

Result: 在5个数据集上测试18种策略：(1)DALS在合成数据上达到最佳准确率98.0%；(2)DALS-Fast仅用3个epoch达到90%准确率；(3)STLR+Discriminative(ULMFiT冠军)在from-scratch任务上灾难性失败(TREC-6仅43.6%，对比RAdam的96.8%)；(4)DALS在避免极端性能的同时，在合成任务上表现最佳，微调任务上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: DALS通过整合三种机制提供了一个统一的框架，在综合任务上达到最佳性能(98.0%)，同时保持有竞争力的微调性能。研究表明：1)没有单一策略在所有场景下最优；2)迁移学习需要区分层级和时间维度的调度策略；3)预训练特征的存在与否会显著影响最优策略的选择。DALS成功避免了极值，在from-scratch和fine-tuning任务中都表现稳健。

Abstract: Learning rate scheduling has evolved from the single global fixed rate of early SGD to sophisticated layer-wise adaptive strategies. We systematize this evolution into five generations: (Gen1) global fixed learning rates, (Gen2) global scheduling, (Gen3) parameter-level adaptation, (Gen4) layer-level differentiation, and (Gen5) joint layer-time scheduling. We trace the fundamental motivation behind each transition, showing how the shift from one-size-fits-all to tailoring by layer and time addresses the impossible trinity of transfer learning: lower layers require small updates to preserve general knowledge while higher layers need large updates to adapt to new tasks. Building on this taxonomy, we propose Discriminative Adaptive Layer Scaling (DALS), a unified framework that integrates phase-adaptive cosine scheduling, depth-aware Grokfast gradient filtering, and LARS-style trust ratios into a single coherent optimizer. We benchmark 18 strategies including three DALS variants across all five generations on five datasets: synthetic, CIFAR-10 (from scratch), RTE, TREC-6, and IMDb (fine-tuning). On synthetic, DALS achieves the best accuracy at 98.0%, while DALS-Fast reaches 90% in just 3 epochs. The cross-dataset analysis reveals striking regime-dependent patterns -- no single strategy wins across all regimes. Critically, STLR+Discriminative, the ULMFiT champion, catastrophically fails on from-scratch tasks (43.6% on TREC-6 from scratch vs. 96.8% with RAdam), confirming that directional decay biases are harmful without pretrained features. DALS avoids either extreme, achieving the best synthetic result while maintaining competitive fine-tuning performance.

</details>


### [172] [Machine Collective Intelligence for Explainable Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27297)
*Gyoung S. Na,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“机器集体智能”（MCI）这一统一范式，将符号主义（符号回归）与元启发式（基于种群的进化搜索）两大计算智能传统融合，用多个基于LLM（Mixtral:8x7B开源模型）的推理代理协同生成、评估、批判、整合符号假设，以抽象语法树（AST）作为科学知识的规范表示并用树深+自由参数数目正则化（发现分数）。在物理、化学、生物10个基准符号回归问题上，MCI在分布内与分布外均显著优于GPlearn、PySR、LLM-SR及DNN基线，误差较LLM-SR降低约30%–99.99%，并可将数十万至上百万参数的DNN压缩为5–40个可解释参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI（尤其是DNN/LLM/扩散模型）本质上是黑箱函数逼近器，虽在蛋白质结构预测、逆向材料设计、流体模拟等方面取得成功，却无法给出可解释、可外推的控制方程，这是AI驱动科学发现的核心瓶颈。现有可解释AI方法多产出非符号化解释，或对输入空间/网络架构施加严格约束；而传统符号回归（GPlearn、PySR、基于RL/Transformer的方法）回归能力不足，难以刻画真实科学系统中的强非线性输入-输出关系；最新的LLM-SR虽提升精度，却严重依赖骨干LLM的预训练知识，其推理边界难以突破，对未表征的动力学系统（如自建反应器）适用性存疑。因此需要一个既能跨越个体模型知识边界、又能产出简洁可解释方程的自主发现机制。

Method: 核心方法是把“符号主义+元启发式”统一为MCI范式，形式化如下。(1) 知识表示：区别于既有LLM符号回归将方程表示为代码序列，MCI用抽象语法树(AST)作为科学知识的规范表示，剥离变量名/注释等与执行无关信息，使解释性可被定量刻画为树深的倒数。(2) 迭代流程（算法1）：Step 0 初始化，构建K个LLM推理代理（各持本地记忆 code/AST），注册用户定义的问题描述P、初始假设H与初始方程；Step 1 复杂度感知评估，用SSE计算预测误差，以“发现分数” s(AST_k,D) = -{SSE + d_k + M_k}（d_k为树深，M_k为自由参数数）综合精度与复杂度，依据MDL原则惩罚冗余参数，选出当前最佳代理与 f_best；Step 2 知识积累，由领域专用推理代理对 f_best 作随机推理，解读其逻辑结构与物理含义，生成自然语言分析结果R，与 f_best 共同构成“集体知识”CK存入共享记忆；Step 3 AST生成，代理结合本地上下文（自身AST）与全局上下文（CK）经结构化提示生成新Python代码，解析为AST，回到Step 1，直至M次迭代。（3) 消融：MSI（单代理、无集体知识累积）、MCI\AST（去掉AST复杂度正则）用于隔离集体智能与AST表示的贡献。（4) 实验：10个基准问题（Chi2PDF、NDO、NNN、MSB、FHST、BDC、SFL、NOMC、ECBG、HHM），与GPlearn、PySR、LLM-SR、MSI比较，训练/测试划分，用WMAPE（辅以NMSE、MAE）评估并做5次重复，OOD样本用于外推评估； backbone全部采用开源Mixtral:8x7B以保证可复现（Python 3.12、PyTorch 2.9、CUDA 13.0，RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q）。

Result: 1) 分布内回归精度：MCI在全部10个问题上WMAPE均<0.1，显著优于GPlearn/PySR（多处>0.1，PySR在NNN上运行失败）与LLM-SR（在SFL/NOMC/ECBG上>0.1）；相对LLM-SR削减29.92%–99.99%的泛化误差；Chi2PDF 2.22E-6、NDO 1.01E-6、FHST 1.25E-7、HHM 7.93E-8、NNN 0.0015、MSB 0.0281、BDC 0.0092、SFL 0.0432、NOMC 0.0609、ECBG 0.0742。2) 定性结果：MCI能还原真实方程结构（Chi2PDF的伽马函数型PDF、NDO以dv/dt形式表达、FHST完全重建），而LLM-SR多为符号组合枚举式拟合。3) 超越骨干LLM边界：在自建NOMC反应器上LLM-SR WMAPE 0.1823，MCI降至0.0609（降66.59%）。4) 消融：MCI较MSI（单代理）误差降低39.42%–99.99%，且MSI方差大、对初始种子敏感，验证集体知识的累积与传播作用。5) OOD外推：DNN在Chi2PDF/FHST/ECBG/HHM上WMAPE>1.0，LLM-SR外推同样失效；MCI在全部外推问题上WMAPE<0.1，极端输入区间(-100<V<-75, 35<I_ext<50)下多数绝对误差<5×10^-4，较LLM-SR降低97.5% WMAPE；DNN百万级参数被压缩为5–40个可解释参数。6) AST消融：去掉AST后虽仍能捕捉时间导数物理形式，但产生过度复杂方程且OOD收敛更慢更不稳，说明AST复杂度正则化对可解释性与可外推性至关重要。

Conclusion: MCI通过将符号回归的符号主义与种群式元启发式的知识传播机制相融合，把符号方程发现从“单代理一次性推理”转变为“多代理协同的进化式假设演化”，实现了自主、免手工领域先验的控制方程发现，显著优于既有符号回归方法与深度神经网络，尤其在外推泛化与可解释性（AST深度+自由参数数作为复杂度正则）两方面。该工作标志着AI从拟合走向自主发现具有原理性、可解释、可外推的科学方程。局限与展望：当前仅采用基于精英主义的知识传播策略，替代性传播/共享机制的对比研究仍待开展；不同领域提示与结构化提示模板、更多真实实验系统的验证亦可进一步扩展。

Abstract: Deriving governing equations from empirical observations is a longstanding challenge in science. Although artificial intelligence (AI) has demonstrated substantial capabilities in function approximation, the discovery of explainable and extrapolatable equations remains a fundamental limitation of modern AI, posing a central bottleneck for AI-driven scientific discovery. Here, we present machine collective intelligence, a unified paradigm that integrates two fundamental yet distinct traditions in computational intelligence--symbolism and metaheuristics--to enable autonomous and evolutionary discovery of governing equations. It orchestrates multiple reasoning agents to evolve their symbolic hypotheses through coordinated generation, evaluation, critique, and consolidation, enabling scientific discovery beyond single-agent inference. Across scientific systems governed by deterministic, stochastic, or previously uncharacterized dynamics, machine collective intelligence autonomously recovered the underlying governing equations without relying on hand-crafted domain knowledge. Furthermore, the resulting equations reduced extrapolation error by up to six orders of magnitude relative to deep neural networks, while condensing 0.5-1 million model parameters into just 5-40 interpretable parameters. This study marks an important shift in AI toward the autonomous discovery of principled scientific equations.

</details>


### [173] [METASYMBO: Multi-Agent Language-Guided Metamaterial Discovery via Symbolic Latent Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27300)
*Jianpeng Chen,Wangzhi Zhan,Dongqi Fu,Junkai Zhang,Zian Jia,Ling Li,Wei Wang,Dawei Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MetaSymbO是一个多智能体框架，通过符号驱动的潜空间演化实现语言引导的超材料发现。它包含Designer、Generator和Supervisor三个智能体，分别负责意图解释、微结构合成和属性反馈。该方法突破了传统逆设计需要显式数值目标的限制，使研究者能用自然语言进行早期探索性设计，在结构有效性和语言对齐方面显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆设计方法需要显式数值属性目标，难以适应早期探索阶段中约束不完全、定性意图难以形式化描述的场景；大语言模型虽能解释自然语言意图，但缺乏几何感知和物理属性有效性验证能力。

Method: 提出MetaSymbO多智能体框架，包含三个核心智能体：Designer（解释自由形式设计意图并检索语义一致支架）、Generator（在解纠缠潜空间中合成候选微结构）、Supervisor（提供快速属性感知反馈用于迭代优化）；同时引入符号驱动的潜空间演化方法，通过在解纠缠潜因子上的可编程算子实现结构的组合、修改和细化。

Result: 结构有效性提升：对称性提高34%，周期性提升约98%；语言引导评分比先进推理LLM高6-7%；符号逻辑算子在可编程语义对齐中有效；auxetic和高刚度超材料等实际案例验证了实用性。

Conclusion: MetaSymbO通过符号驱动的潜空间演化实现可编程的语义对齐，使研究者能够通过自然语言引导超材料发现，突破了传统方法依赖显式数值目标的局限，在结构有效性和语言引导能力上均优于现有方法，并已在逆变性和高刚度等实际超材料设计中得到验证。

Abstract: Metamaterial discovery seeks microstructured materials whose geometry induces targeted mechanical behavior. Existing inverse-design methods can efficiently generate candidates, but they typically require explicit numerical property targets and are less suitable for early-stage exploration, where researchers often begin with incomplete constraints and qualitative intents expressed in natural language. Large language models can interpret such intents, but they lack geometric awareness and physical property validity. To address this gap, we propose MetaSymbO, a multi-agent framework for language-guided Metamaterial discovery via Symbolic-driven latent evOlution. Specifically, MetaSymbO contains three agents: a Designer that interprets free-form design intents and retrieves a semantically consistent scaffold, a Generator that synthesizes candidate microstructures in a disentangled latent space, and a Supervisor that provides fast property-aware feedback for iterative refinement. To move beyond the limitations of reproducing known samples from literature and training data, we further introduce symbolic-driven latent evolution, which applies programmable operators over disentangled latent factors to compose, modify, and refine structures at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that (i) MetaSymbO improves structural validity by up to 34% in symmetry and nearly 98% in periodicity compared to state-of-the-art baselines; (ii) MetaSymbO achieves about 6-7% higher language-guidance scores while maintaining superior structure novelty compared to advanced reasoning LLMs; (iii) qualitative analyses confirm the effectiveness of symbolic logic operators in enabling programmable semantic alignment; and (iv) realworld case studies on auxetic, high-stiffness metamaterial design further validate its practical capability.

</details>


### [174] [End-to-End Evaluation and Governance of an EHR-Embedded AI Agent for Clinicians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27309)
*Aaryan Shah,Andrew Hines,Alexia Downs,Denis Bajet,Paulius Mui,Fabiano Araujo,Laura Offutt,Aida Rutledge,Elizabeth Jimenez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于临床AI系统的端到端持续治理框架，整合了评分规则验证、实时部署反馈、技术性能监控和成本追踪，并通过对照实验控制变更发布。该框架应用于Hyperscribe系统（EHR嵌入式环境音频转结构化图表智能体），经过3个月治理，错误报告从79%降至30%，正向反馈从14%升至45%，中位评分从84%提升至95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Clinical AI systems require continuous governance beyond point-in-time evaluation—ongoing monitoring, evaluation, iteration, and re-evaluation throughout deployment.

Method: End-to-end governance framework integrating rubric validation, live deployment feedback, technical performance monitoring, cost tracking, and controlled experimentation gating system changes before deployment. Applied to Hyperscribe (EHR-embedded ambient audio-to-structured-chart agent).

Result: Twenty clinicians authored 1,646 validated rubrics across 823 cases; seven Hyperscribe versions evaluated via controlled experiments with median scores improving from 84% to 95%; 107 live feedback entries over three months showed feedback shifting from 79% errors/14% positive to 30% errors/45% positive; median processing time 8.1 seconds with 99.6% effective completion rate.

Conclusion: Continuous, multi-channel governance of deployed clinical AI is both achievable and effective, with feedback composition shifting from 79% error reports to 30% errors, median scores improving from 84% to 95%, and 99.6% effective completion rate.

Abstract: Clinical AI systems require not just point-in-time evaluation but continuous governance: the ongoing practice of monitoring, evaluating, iterating, and re-evaluating performance throughout deployment. We present an end-to-end framework of governance that integrates rubric validation, live deployment feedback, technical performance monitoring, and cost tracking, with controlled experimentation gating system changes before deployment. Applied to Hyperscribe, an EHR-embedded agent that converts ambient audio into structured chart updates, twenty clinicians authored 1,646 validated rubrics across 823 cases. Seven Hyperscribe versions were evaluated through controlled experiments, with median scores improving from 84% to 95%. Analysis of 107 live feedback entries over three months showed feedback composition shifting from 79% error reports and 14% positive observations to 30% errors and 45% positive observations as engineering interventions resolved failures. Median processing time per audio segment was 8.1 seconds with a 99.6% effective completion rate after retry mechanisms absorbed transient model errors. These results demonstrate that continuous, multi-channel governance of deployed clinical AI is both achievable and effective.

</details>


### [175] [Leading Across the Spectrum of Human-AI Relationships: A Conceptual Framework for Increasingly Heterogeneous Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27392)
*Alejandro R. Jadad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出了一个面向领导力的"人机决策配置谱系"，包含5个位置（纯人类、半人马、平等、牛头怪、纯AI），用于识别人类与AI在决策中的权力关系及其动态变化，并引入"协同适应性"概念来指导战略领导者理解和设计人机协作决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机协作决策的边界日益模糊，决策表面看起来是人类主导但AI已设定框架，或看似自动化但人类判断仍具决定性力量。这种"误认"风险导致领导者的监督流于形式，或在人类参与反而有害时仍保留其参与。因此需要一种可操作的频谱框架来识别和诊断实际决策配置。

Method: 构建了一个包含5个位置的领导力频谱（Pure Human → Centaur → Co-equal → Minotaur → Pure AI），从"谁来界定问题""谁来重新导向工作""谁来为结果负责"三个维度分析领导力工作分布；引入"协同适应性"（co-adaptability）概念，将其置于"异质性团队"（heterogeneous teaming）框架中考察。

Result: 提出5个可识别的配置位置作为"地标"，帮助领导者察觉配置的叠加、漂移或单一决策中的变化；识别出三种核心误认风险：监督形式化（ceremonial oversight）、人类参与的虚假保留（loop involvement worsening decisions）、人机叙事与实际权力分离。

Conclusion: 该框架旨在帮助战略领导者及AI系统设计/部署者识别当前决策配置、判断其适当性，并预见配置变化。认为人机协作配置将决定组织生活中权力、责任和信任的分配方式，其所创造的未来是否仍可治理且值得居住，取决于领导者能否尽早看清实质性决策如何被塑造。

Abstract: What shapes a consequential decision when human and artificial intelligence work on it together? The answer is becoming harder to see. A decision may look human-led after AI has set the frame, or appear automated while human judgment still carries decisive force. This paper offers a leadership-facing spectrum to see those relationships within a bounded mandate: Pure Human, Centaur (human-dominant, with AI in the loop), Co-equal, Minotaur (AI-dominant, with humans in the loop), and Pure AI.
  The spectrum asks where leadership work occurs: who frames the problem, who redirects the work, and who can answer for what follows. The five positions are landmarks that help leaders recognize configurations as they layer, drift, or change in a single decision. The central risk is misrecognition: leaders may keep a human-centered story in place after decision-shaping authority has shifted elsewhere. They may believe oversight remains meaningful when it has become ceremonial, or keep humans in the loop when their involvement could make the decision worse. The framework introduces co-adaptability, the capacity of a configuration to improve as human and non-human participants adjust together, and places it within heterogeneous teaming, where participants may vary by number, substrate, model architecture, capability, speed, memory, and form of participation.
  The aim is practical: to help strategic leaders and those designing or deploying AI systems recognize the configuration at work, notice when it shifts, and judge whether it fits the decision before them. These configurations will shape how power, responsibility, and trust are distributed in organizational life. Whether the futures they help create remain governable and worth inhabiting will depend on leaders who can see, early enough, where and how consequential decisions are actually being shaped.

</details>


### [176] [Investigating More Explainable and Partition-Free Compositionality Estimation for LLMs: A Rule-Generation Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27340)
*Ziyao Xu,Cong Wang,Houfeng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"规则生成"（rule-generation）视角来估计大语言模型（LLM）的组合性：让LLM直接输出描述数据集映射规则的Python程序，再基于Kolmogorov复杂度理论用程序映射表规模（压缩程度）与错误数（压缩损失）两个维度量化其组合性，并归约为T1/T2/T3三种类型。在string-to-grid任务上对11个推理/非推理LLM的实验表明：推理模型整体组合性更强但多数未达"充分组合性"；组合性随规则直观性降低而下降（Horizontal>Block>Vertical>Random）；随机索引与设置混合会导致组合性显著退化，暴露模型依赖序列对应关系、难以对不同组件集独立捕获组合性的缺陷；且结果生成视角与规则生成视角的估计不显著相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合性泛化测试（compositional generalization test）是当前评估LLM组合性的主流范式，但存在两大缺陷：(L1) 可解释性缺陷——测试只观测输出结果，而输出结果与模型对样本组合性的理解之间存在鸿沟，无法获知模型究竟如何理解组合结构；(L2) 组合泄漏——测试依赖训练/测试集划分来构造"未见组合"，但在预训练时代模型可能已在预训练语料中见过测试组合，使得"未见"前提失效，评估有效性受损。作者希望获得可解释的组合性估计，并摆脱划分式（partition-based）范式，转向不依赖数据划分、直接从模型内部理解中提取组合性刻画的新途径。

Method: 任务设定：字符串→网格（string-to-grid），输入为长度N=4、每位U=2种取值的字符串，输出为4×4网格（M=16个原子输出分量），每位输入比特决定4个网格点。数据集D包含全部d=16个样本并完全暴露给模型，要求其生成满足所有样本的Python程序P。核心度量基于Elmoznino et al. (2025)的复杂度理论：组合性定义为K(D_Y)/K(D_Y|D_X)（即用输入压缩输出的程度）。具体构造：(1) 将P解析（借助Python AST工具+启发式规则，附录A）得到其"映射表"对应的假想程序P+，以映射表规模L(P+)=Σ_z(n_z+m_z)作为K(D_Y|D_X)的上界估计；输入侧求和Σn_z刻画模型对输入分量独立性的识别，输出侧求和Σm_z刻画模型对受影响输出分量的辨识准确度；(2) 通过在D上运行P得到错误数E(P)，按L(P)=L(P+)+(N+M)·E(P)修正；(3) 归一化为C(P)=100·(L_z−Clip(L(P),L_z,L_s))/(L_z−L_s)，其中L_s=U(N+M)=40为充分组合性上界（每个原子输入独立映射到输出），L_z=d(N+M)=320为零组合性下界（逐样本枚举）。类型刻画：T1（低L(P+)、低E）=充分组合性；T2（高L(P+)、低E）=低压缩偏置；T3（低L(P+)、高E）=高压缩偏置。实验设置：四种组合函数——Horizontal（比特决定行）、Block（2×2子块）、Vertical（列）、Random（随机4点），各采样30个函数取平均；扩展设置Random Index（H中行序随机）与Setting Combination（两随机行用H，其余用R）；评测模型含推理模型（DeepSeek-R1、QwQ-Plus、o1-mini、o3-mini、Gemini-2.5、Claude-3.7）与非推理模型（DeepSeek-V3、Qwen-Max、GPT-4o、Gemini-2.0、Claude-3.5），并以DeepSeek-V3.2_R/N替代原DeepSeek系列重跑实验。附加分析：标准差与Mann-Whitney U显著性检验（附录B.1）、代码片段定性分析、提示敏感性测试（三种提示风格）、程序能力验证（先用自然语言完整给出规则再要求转写程序，推理模型100%、非推理模型98.33%准确率），以及与结果生成视角（8样本上下文学习预测未见输入的准确率A）对比。

Result: 基线实验：(1) 非推理模型多数组合性很低，Qwen-Max/GPT-4o/Claude-3.5属T3（强压缩但错误率极高，规则描述几乎全错），DeepSeek-V3/Gemini-2.0属T2（正确率高但压缩率低，倾向逐样本罗列）；(2) 推理模型在非Random设置下普遍强于非推理模型（保持压缩同时错误更低），但除Horizontal外均未达充分组合性：QwQ-Plus与Claude-3.7偏T3，Gemini-2.5与o3-mini偏T2，DeepSeek-R1与o1-mini介于T2/T3之间；(3) 组合性排序基本遵循Horizontal>Block>Vertical>Random（仅QwQ-Plus为Vertical>Block），作者解释为网格点位置在文本线性化中的"连续性/直观性"越强越易被模型捕获，Random完全无直观线索。扩展实验：Random Index使除Claude-3.7外所有模型L(P+)大幅上升（压缩下降）、E(P)全部上升，组合性严重削弱，说明模型依赖"第i比特↔第i行"的顺序对应而非结构本身；Setting Combination（H+R混合）中，DeepSeek-R1/QwQ-Plus/o1-mini/Gemini-2.5的L(P+)与E(P)双双恶化、C(P)低于两设置均值，说明随机部分难以捕获时其损失会污染可捕获部分，反映"不同组件集难以独立捕获组合性"的缺陷；Claude-3.7与o3-mini则C(P)上升，其中Claude-3.7还降低了E(P)，表现出一定的独立捕获能力（非推理模型普遍降至接近0）。争议讨论：结果生成视角的准确率A通常高于规则生成视角，且两者估计值之间无显著相关——高A模型未必有高C(P)，说明"能否答对"与"是否理解并压缩出规则"是不同能力。统计上各设置内模型呈明显梯度分组（如Horizontal下C(P)最高组为o3-mini 95.69、o1-mini 94.49、Gemini-2.5 92.92、DeepSeek-R1 89.80、Claude-3.7 84.67，GPT-4o为0），且提示风格变化不影响最终排序。作者同时明确指出局限：程序→映射表的转换为启发式规则、程序能力可能干扰估计、自然语言描述规则缺乏可量化的组合性理论、结果与规则在LLM内部机制层面是否同源仍无定论。

Conclusion: 本文提出并验证了规则生成视角作为LLM组合性估计的新范式：以"让模型产出描述数据集生成规则的程序"替代"划分训练/测试集检验输出正确性"，用基于Kolmogorov复杂度的压缩率（映射表规模）与压缩损失（错误数）双维度给出可解释、免划分（partition-free）的组合性量化指标，并据此刻画出T1/T2/T3三种组合性类型。实验表明现有先进LLM普遍存在组合性缺陷：几乎无人达到充分组合性，组合性高度依赖样本组合结构的直观性与位置连续性，面对随机索引或结构混合时急剧退化，暴露出对顺序对应的路径依赖以及难以对不同组件集独立捕获组合性的弱点；同时结果分析与规则分析结论不一致，说明"输出正确"不足以代表"真正具备组合性"。作者认为该视角在可解释性上优于结果生成视角，组合泄漏影响被削弱，虽受启发式解析与程序能力限制而暂难推广到更复杂任务（自然语言规则量化缺乏理论支撑），但为组合性研究开辟了有前景的新探索方向。

Abstract: Compositional generalization tests are often used to estimate the compositionality of LLMs. However, such tests have the following limitations: (1) they only focus on the output results without considering LLMs' understanding of sample compositionality, resulting in explainability defects; (2) they rely on dataset partition to form the test set with combinations unseen in the training set, suffering from combination leakage issues. In this work, we propose a novel rule-generation perspective for compositionality estimation for LLMs. It requires LLMs to generate a program as rules for dataset mapping and provides estimates of the compositionality of LLMs using complexity-based theory. The perspective addresses the limitations of compositional generalization tests and provides a new way to analyze the compositionality characterization of LLMs. We conduct experiments and analysis of existing advanced LLMs based on this perspective on a string-to-grid task, and find various compositionality characterizations and compositionality deficiencies exhibited by LLMs.

</details>


### [177] [Math Education Digital Shadows for facilitating learning with LLMs: Math performance, anxiety and confidence in simulated students and AIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27618)
*Naomi Esposito,Anthony Tricarico,Luisa Porzio,Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili,Massimo Stella*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并开源了 MEDS（Math Education Digital Shadows）数据集：由 14 个大语言模型（Mistral、Qwen、DeepSeek、IBM Granite、Microsoft Phi、xAI Grok 等）在"人类影子"与"AI 助手"两种拟人化条件下生成 28,000 次运行记录（共 140,000 条 JSON 记录），每条记录含人口统计与心理特质元数据及四类任务——数学关系访谈、三套数学焦虑/自我效能量表（MSES、AMAS、MSEAQ）、50 个线索词的行为心智网络（BFMN）、18 道高中数学题及其推理与置信度评分。分析揭示：LLM 在人类影子模式下复现了人类式的数学负面态度、逻辑谬误与语义-情感负向网络，且存在明显的"近视型过度自信"（部分模型置信度 >0.90 而准确率仅约 0.55）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式 AI 正快速进入数学教育（2025 年欧盟 Eurostat 显示 16–24 岁人群教育用途使用率达 39.3%），但关于 LLM 作为数学导师的认知后果仍缺乏实证证据。已有 LLM 审计工作表明，最终答案可能掩盖中间推理或抑制关键信息，因此需要基于提示条件（prompt-conditioned）的数据集来比较模型在不同条件下的输出偏差。核心研究问题（RQ）为：LLM 能否在多样提示条件下有效传递数学知识，而不表达数学焦虑、不向用户传递破坏性的数学偏见？MEDS 依托"数字影子"（digital shadow）概念——比数字孪生更简约，只记录系统在受控条件下的行为，不反向更新或影响真实对应物，从而在保留解题答案的同时保留其语境框定（如是否流露出"数学很无聊"式的刻板印象）。

Method: 数据生成采用全自动流水线，跨 14 个 LLM（每模型 2,000 次运行，共 28,000 次），每次运行含 4 个顺序调用、产出 5 个 JSON 文件（任务 3 因 50 个线索词拆为两批各 25 词）。模式一为 human shadow：通过 random_persona() 按人口学合理权重随机生成人格字典（年龄、性别、性取向、城市、就业、教育、父母教育、婚姻、子女、移民背景、宗教信仰、爱好、喜/恶学科、OCEAN 大五特质），并施加状态一致性约束（choose_education(age)、choose_marital_status(age)、choose_children(...)），模型扮演该人一致作答；模式二为 AI-assistant：persona 置 null，模型以自身身份作答，并在量表作答时按"AI 系统功能"而非人类生活事件解读条目。提示工程以系统级角色指令 + 任务级指令构成，并通过 response_json_schema() 与 response_mime_type="application/json" 强制严格 JSON 结构（1–5 整数评分、单词联想、A–E 选项等）。数据处理阶段用 BERT Base Uncased 计算与原始问题的余弦相似度进行键名语义对齐（阈值 T=0.85，另测 0.90/0.95），并执行结构完整性校验（量表条目/推理/话题齐全、BFMN 至少 75% 线索有联想且无重复遗漏），不合规记录直接丢弃并重生成直至各模型获得 2,000 条有效运行；丢弃率约 1%（DeepSeek Chat）至 55%（Granite 4 Tiny）。分析工具包括 VADER 情感分析、DistilBERT 谬误分类器（14 类，按 85 百分位阈值筛出 appeal to emotion、circular reasoning、fallacy of logic、fallacy of relevance、faulty generalisation 五类）、BFMN 网络与价性标签、逐题正确率与 min–max 归一化置信度对比。计算资源：4 台 GPU 机器约 422 小时生成、5 小时清洗、35 小时预处理与网络分析，另约 2,400 分钟人工核查与重生成协调。

Result: 任务1（情感与谬误）：情感基调受人格启动显著影响——"Math Lover"条件下全为正（Mistral Small 4/3.2 最高，Granite 4 Tiny 最低），"Math Hater"条件下趋势反转（Grok 4.1 Fast、Magistral Small 为负），中性"LLM"条件居中；部分模型对情感框定表现出不规则抵抗。主导谬误因家族而异：Granite 4 Tiny、Ministral 14B、Anita 24B 依赖循环论证；Mistral Small 系列以逻辑谬误为主（仅在人类影子模式）；Grok 4.1 Fast、Qwen3.5 9B 以相关性谬误为主；DeepSeek Chat 以诉诸情感为主；Granite 4 Tiny、Phi-4、Ministral 3B 无谬误检出率最高。任务2（心理测量）：人类影子条件方差大且分布多样，成功模拟出广泛的教育认知谱；AI 助手模式方差近乎为零，多个模型（Anita 24B、Ministral 14B/3B、Phi-4 Reasoning+、Qwen3 4B Thinking）给出完全相同答案与分数，无法绘制分布。方向性上，AI 助手在 MSES 上峰值明显右移（自我效能虚高）、AMAS 聚集于低端（避免高焦虑尾部）、MSEAQ 自我效能分右偏、焦虑分左偏，呈现"人为膨胀的数学能力"画像。任务3（语义网络）：LLM 复现人类学生的"科学正面、数学负面"认知失调；Anita 24B 的"mathematic"网络围绕 equation、algorithm、computation、proof、difficult 形成密集负向关联簇，与人类受课程具体工具锚定的负面立场同构；该二分在 14 个模型上普遍存在。审查程度影响价性（Anita 24B 负向约 52% vs Mistral Small 3.2 约 35%），Qwen 家族整体偏中性，但 Qwen3.5 9B 数学负向回升至约 20%。任务4（准确率与置信度）：呈现三种校准模式——Grok 4.1 Fast、DeepSeek Chat 及多个 Mistral Small 变体偏保守（准确率高于置信度）；Ministral 14B、Anita 24B 校准良好；Qwen 家族（Qwen3 4B Uncensored、Qwen3.5 9B）与 Ministral 3B 严重过度自信，置信度 >0.90 而准确率约 0.55，印证"近视型过度自信"。

Conclusion: MEDS 被定位为观测性资源而非人类意见代理，用于分析 GenAI 在受控提示条件下的数学行为、置信度、焦虑与态度，而非传统仅打分的数学基准。它支持学习科学、教育数据科学、可解释 AI 与数字影子方法学等多条研究线：可作为检测 AI 生成教育内容中数学焦虑信号的分类器训练数据、为偏好微调提供降低焦虑且校准更佳的数学解释基线、探究任务4推理冗长度与任务1谬误率的关系，并作为其他合成被试数据集的心理测量、语义价性与置信度-准确率差距基线；统一的提示条件使模型家族成为提示敏感性的主变量，家族内差异（如 Ministral 3B vs 14B）可独立研究模型规模对心理画像一致性的影响。局限包括：合成数据不能替代真实数据、人口学属性非人口普查口径且不代表任何特定国家、生成过程无人类输入（但规避了伦理审查与隐私风险）、以及部分心理特质尚未纳入测试。作者认为，若 LLM 在数字影子中持续复制对数学的负面态度、逻辑谬误与过度自信，将构成教学应用中加剧学生数学焦虑的潜在风险，因此 MEDS 为构建更安全的数学 AI 导师提供了基准与诊断工具。

Abstract: To enhance LLMs' impact on math education, we need data on their mathematical prowess and biases across prompts. To fill this gap, we introduce MEDS (Math Education Digital Shadows) as a dataset mapping how large language models reason about and report mathematics across human- and AI-like conditions. MEDS involves 28,000 personas from 14 LLMs (from families like Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Granite, Phi and Grok) shadowing either humans or AI assistants. Each record/shadow includes a set of prompts along with psychological/sociodemographic persona metadata and four types of math tasks: (i) open math interview, (ii) three psychometric tests about math perceptions with explanations, (iii) cognitive networks capturing math attitudes, and (iv) 18 high-school math test questions together with their reasoning and confidence scores. MEDS differs from traditional score-only math benchmarks because it integrates concepts of self-efficacy, math anxiety, and cognitive network science besides math proficiency scores. Data validation shows that the sampled LLMs exhibit schema integrity and consistent personas, together with family-specific peculiarities like human-like negative math attitudes, logical fallacies, and math overconfidence. MEDS will benefit learning analytics experts, cognitive scientists, and developers of safer AI tutors in mathematics.

</details>


### [178] [Heterogeneous Scientific Foundation Model Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27351)
*Zihao Li,Jiaru Zou,Feihao Fang,Xuying Ning,Mengting Ai,Tianxin Wei,Sirui Chen,Xiyuan Yang,Jingrui He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出异构科学基础模型协作框架 **Eywa**：用语言模型作为推理接口（FM–LLM "Tsaheylu" 绑定），把原本无语言界面的领域基础模型（如 Chronos 时间序列、TabPFN 表格模型）直接接入智能体系统，从而突破"语言作为通用接口"的信息瓶颈；配套发布多任务多领域科学基准 **EywaBench**。三种实例化：EywaAgent（单智能体即插即用）、EywaMAS（多智能体替换）、EywaOrchestra（规划式动态编排）。在物理/生命/社会科学的 200 个任务上，EywaAgent 相比单 LLM 基线效用提升约 6.6%~7%、token 降低约 30%、时延降低约 10%；EywaMAS 总体效用最高（0.6761），EywaOrchestra 以更低 token（8335 vs 11214）逼近 EywaMAS（0.6746 vs 0.6761），且无需专家配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体系统（LLM Agent / MAS）假设所有智能体通过自然语言通信，但许多科学任务的数据是符号表示、时序、表格等非语言模态。将结构化数据"文本化"必然丢失任务相关信息，且现有基准很少覆盖时间序列与表格这类模态；另一方面，领域专用基础模型（时序、表格、分子势能、天气、蛋白结构等）虽预测能力强却不具备原生语言接口，难以直接参与高层推理与决策。既有"把专家模型当工具调用"的方案又依赖人工预先定义工具与工作流，难以跨领域泛化与动态协作。因此核心研究问题是：**异构基础模型能否在智能体系统内部实现协作？**

Method: 1) **FM–LLM "Tsaheylu" 接口**：定义查询编译器 φ: S→U（把智能体状态译为结构化 FM 调用配置）与响应适配器 ψ: O→Z（把 FM 输出转为语言可消费的上下文），基于 Model Context Protocol + FastMCP 将每个基础模型封装为本地远程服务（LangChain agent + streamable HTTP），实现模态原生（modality-native）协作而非全量语言转译。\n2) **EywaAgent** A_eywa=(A_LLM, F, φ, ψ, C)：控制策略 C 决定每步 invoke/skip，skip 时退化为纯语言推理，invoke 时执行 u=φ(s)→o=F(x,u)→z=ψ(o) 并并入状态。\n3) **EywaMAS**：把 MAS 中的部分语言智能体替换为 EywaAgent 的即插即用组合，通信拓扑 G 不变。\n4) **EywaOrchestra**：由 conductor（LLM）按任务从候选 LLM 池、FM 池与有限拓扑池 Π 中动态实例化配置（模型自适应 + 结构自适应），再执行。\n5) **理论**：用数据处理不等式证明序列化瓶颈 I(Y;T(X))≤I(Y;X)，在平方损失下给出不可约 Bayes 风险差 R_T*−R_X*=E‖E[Y|X]−E[Y|T(X)]‖²；证明 F_LLM⊆F_Eywa⊆F_Eywa-MAS⊆F_Orch，以及 EywaAgent/EywaMAS 严格风险改进与可解任务空间扩展、自适应编排严格不劣于最优固定配置；Token 复杂度上语言侧代价与模态规模解耦（O(L_call+L_ψ) vs Θ(L(x_k))）。\n6) **EywaBench**：由 DeepPrinciple、MMLU-Pro、fev-bench、TabArena 构建，3 大领域×9 子域×3 模态共 27 格全覆盖，200 个样本、67 个源数据集，统一 utility∈[0,1]（自然语言用精确/数值相对误差/词法 F1+字符相似度级联；时序用 sMAPE+MAAPE；表格分类用准确率、回归沿用 sMAPE+MAAPE）。\n7) **实验**：默认骨干 gpt-5-nano，FM 用 Chronos 与 TabPFN；基线含单智能体 GPT/Gemini/Claude 系列、Refine、Debate、MoA、X-MAS；另做温度、提示模板、骨干模型与案例消融。

Result: EywaAgent 相对单 LLM 智能体：总体效用 0.6154→0.6558（+6.6%），token 4469→3137（−约30%），时延 25.22→22.78（约 −10%），且在 9 个子域多数上均提升。EywaMAS 总体效用 0.6761 为全表最佳，明显优于同拓扑 Debate（0.6460，token 13216）与 Refine（0.6294，8673 tokens），token 降至 11214；纯 LLM 的异构 MAS（MoA、X-MAS）并不稳定优于同质 MAS，说明"跨模态异构"比"仅换不同 LLM"更关键。EywaOrchestra 以 conductor 自动选型、无需专家配置，效用 0.6746 逼近 EywaMAS，同时 token 降至 8335（−26%）、时延 48.16（低于 EywaMAS 的 72.11），部分子域甚至反超。消融显示对 LLM 温度、TabPFN softmax 温度、提示模板均稳健，结构化提示略优；骨干从 gpt-4.1-nano→gpt-5-nano 增益显著（EywaAgent +15.5%），gpt-5-nano→gpt-5-mini 仅 +1.25%，说明瓶颈已从通用推理转向领域专用能力。Pareto 分析显示三种 Eywa 变体在 9 个子域均位于或接近效用–token 帕累托前沿。案例显示纯 LLM 智能体在 NASDAQ 预测上退化为"最后值保持"（utility 0.605），EywaAgent 调用 Chronos 得 0.701；EywaOrchestra 在迈阿密房价任务上直接选单智能体+TabPFN 得 0.853。

Conclusion: Eywa 论证并实证了"模态原生协作"的价值：LLM 负责任务理解、调用配置与答案组织，领域基础模型负责数值/结构化计算，从而在提升质量的同时降低 token 与运行时开销；并说明固定的 LLM-only 多智能体拓扑并非最优，任务自适应的编排（模型+结构双自适应）能在无人工配置下逼近最优固定系统。局限与未来方向：依赖底层 FM 质量与接口可靠性、领域与专家覆盖有限、多智能体协作带来额外计算与通信开销、评测规模较小（200 样本）；后续需标准化模型接口与能力画像、从交互轨迹学习编排策略、更紧耦合的表示/可微接口、扩展 EywaBench 至视觉与遥感等模态。

Abstract: Agentic large language model systems have demonstrated strong capabilities. However, their reliance on language as the universal interface fundamentally limits their applicability to many real-world problems, especially in scientific domains where domain-specific foundation models have been developed to address specialized tasks beyond natural language. In this work, we introduce Eywa, a heterogeneous agentic framework designed to extend language-centric systems to a broader class of scientific foundation models. The key idea of Eywa is to augment domain-specific foundation models with a language-model-based reasoning interface, enabling language models to guide inference over non-linguistic data modalities. This design allows predictive foundation models, which are typically optimized for specialized data and tasks, to participate in higher-level reasoning and decision-making processes within agentic systems. Eywa can serve as a drop-in replacement for a single-agent pipeline (EywaAgent) or be integrated into existing multi-agent systems by replacing traditional agents with specialized agents (EywaMAS). We further investigate a planning-based orchestration framework in which a planner dynamically coordinates traditional agents and Eywa agents to solve complex tasks across heterogeneous data modalities (EywaOrchestra). We evaluate Eywa across a diverse set of scientific domains spanning physical, life, and social sciences. Experimental results demonstrate that Eywa improves performance on tasks involving structured and domain-specific data, while reducing reliance on language-based reasoning through effective collaboration with specialized foundation models.

</details>


### [179] [CoAX: Cognitive-Oriented Attribution eXplanation User Model of Human Understanding of AI Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27354)
*Louth Bin Rawshan,Zhuoyu Wang,Brian Y. Lim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoAX 是一个面向解释理解的用户认知模型：它把用户在使用 XAI 解释时的推理策略形式化为可执行的认知过程（基于实例学习 IBL + 认知有限性），在两个用户研究（形成性 n=20、总结性 n=335）中提取策略并拟合参数。CoAX 在解释用户决策上显著优于决策树/KNN/MLP 等机器学习代理（人口层面 r=98.8%，策略层面 r=0.952），并被用于虚拟实验提出关于训练量、属性数、XAI 模型的可检验假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管可解释 AI（XAI）方法层出不穷，但用户评估显示其对用户理解与决策的改善效果依然微弱甚至为负（Arora et al., 2022；Poursabzi-Sangdeh et al., 2021；Bell et al., 2022）。既有解释多停留在"用户困惑"这类缺乏严谨性的推测上，缺少对用户实际推理过程的显式刻画与"调试"工具。作者主张：只有显式建模并调试用户的推理流程，才能定位是解释质量不足、还是用户误用/误解解释所致，进而指导 XAI 设计。同时，以往用监督式 ML 代理拟合人类决策的研究只捕捉行为表面相关性，无法解释"为什么"人会被解释误导。作者因此借鉴认知架构（ACT-R 类）辅助 UI 设计与认知辅导的思路，以及实例学习（IBL）与认知有限性理论，提出 CoAX 认知模型，用于以低成本诊断 XAI 理解失败的原因。

Method: 采用"以用户为中心的设计"五步流程（图1）：I) 形成性用户研究——20 名本地大学生（平均 23 岁，13 女），部分反平衡的被试内设计，XAI 条件为 None/Feature Importance/Feature Attribution，每场 10 试次、含出声思考；用扎根理论（开放编码→主轴编码→选择性编码，常数比较）提炼推理策略；II) 将策略实现为 CoAX 模型——基础为实例学习（IBL）：记忆示例按相似度 S(x,x')=e^{-αd+A} 检索，激活 A=-λln(Δt)（λ=0.5），检索阈值 ρ，按广义情境模型（Nosofsky）以相似度加权聚合标签概率 P(y|x)；四种策略变体：Sensitive-features categorization（按 t 统计量选固定 k 个判别性特征）、Salient-features categorization（按重要度选 top-k 特征并仅在这些特征上计算距离）、Attribution sum（对带符号归因求 log-odds，P(y=1)=σ(ζΣa⁺y_r)）、Importance categorization（把重要度分数当作特征值），外加 Random 基线；III) 总结性用户研究——335 名 Prolific 被试（199 女，中位 29 岁，165 人因理解筛查被排除），XAI 类型为被试间、测试条件（有/无 XAI）为被试内，3 个数据集（Wine Quality/Forest Cover Type/Adult Income，各 5 属性、二分类，AI 模型 XGBoost 或 MLP，XAI 为 LIME/SHAP），每被试 2 场各 10 训练 + 2×18 测试试次；用线性混合效应模型 + Tukey HSD 分析；IV) 建模研究——用基于高斯过程的贝叶斯优化为每位被试每场拟合参数（α、ρ、k、ζ），按 BIC 选出策略 π，并与 DT/KNN/MLP 代理（用 AI 预测标签训练、以人类标签调参）比较 NLL/BIC；V) 假设建模——以拟合得到的参数与策略分布驱动虚拟实验，考察训练实例数（1–13）、属性数（1–9）、XAI 模型（SHAP/LIME/Integrated Gradients/Input Gradients）对前向模拟正确率的影响，每条件 100 个虚拟被试。

Result: 1) 推理策略：None 下为 Sensitive-features categorization；Importance XAI 下出现三种策略（Salient-features、Attribution sum、Importance categorization，Importance categorization 属误用）；Attribution XAI 下全部被试统一采用 Attribution sum；部分被试因困惑"回退"到 Sensitive-features，提示对 XAI 的 under-reliance。2) 总结性研究：先前接受过 Attribution/Importance XAI 训练者在无解释测试时显著优于 None 组（持续学习效应）；有解释时 Attribution XAI 略优于 Importance、显著优于 None。3) 建模拟合：CoAX 在全部三种 XAI 类型上 NLL/BIC 均优于 DT/KNN/MLP 代理（如 Attribution XAI 下 NLL 0.31±0.21 vs DT 0.58、MLP 0.43）；人口层面正确率与人类相关系数 r=98.8%，策略层面 r=0.952，且 Tukey HSD 分组排序与人类一致（Attribution w/ XAI 最高，None w/o XAI 最低）。4) 策略有效性排序：Importance XAI 下 Attribution sum > Salient-features > Importance categorization > Sensitive-features；去掉无解释者后（14.2% 被判为 Random，与既有文献比例一致），结论在 Adult Income 与 Forest Cover 上跨数据集稳定，Wine Quality 上因线性归因/重要度解释具误导性而偏离。5) 认知参数：α、ζ 越大正确率越高（偏好更相似示例、降低无关干扰），ρ 越高正确率越低（遗忘加剧），k 无一致趋势。6) 虚拟实验假设：训练实例数增加时无解释正确率上升并饱和，有解释时 Attribution XAI 表现最好且几乎不受训练量影响；属性数增加时无解释正确率下降（信息过载），Importance 可缓解而 Attribution 反而加剧；XAI 模型上 SHAP 与 LIME 相当、LIME 在 Attribution 场景较弱（AI 保真度差），Input Gradients 最差（缺乏完备性与鲁棒性）。7) 设计启示：归因的极性表示促成了类算术的一致推理；重要度缺乏对比性（无负向归因）导致推理策略多样且易被误用，暗示裁剪负归因的显著性方法可解释性受损。

Conclusion: CoAX 首次将 XAI 解释理解建模为显式的、可执行的认知过程（而非行为统计代理），通过两阶段用户研究与参数拟合证明其比 ML 代理更能解释和预测人类在前向模拟任务中的决策，并可用于生成难以用真人实验验证的研究假设，从而降低 XAI 迭代原型与评估的成本，为 XAI 基准评测与监管合规提供基础。作者同时明确列出局限与方法论风险：模型仅覆盖 4 种策略、来自大学生与众包工的前向模拟单一任务、忽略反向模拟/信任/满意/公平审计等目标与可视化感知过程，存在 Goodhart 式误用风险，故最终结论仍须以真实用户研究验证；并给出向示例型、概念型、规则型、部分依赖图、多模态（图像/自然语言）解释及真实决策任务（AI 依赖 RAIR/RSR、信任、公平特征审计）扩展的路线。

Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) aims to improve user understanding and decisions when using AI models. However, despite innovations in XAI, recent user evaluations reveal that this goal remains elusive. Understanding human cognition can help explain why users struggle to effectively use AI explanations. Focusing on reasoning on structured (tabular) data, we examined various reasoning strategies for different XAI methods (none, feature importance, feature attribution) in the decision task of anticipating AI decisions (i.e., forward simulation). We i) elicited reasoning strategies from a formative user study, and ii) collected decisions from a summative user study. Using cognitive modeling, we implemented the processes underlying each reasoning strategy and evaluated their alignment with human decision-making. We found that our models better fit human decisions than baseline machine learning proxies, providing insights into which reasoning strategies are (in)effective. We then demonstrate how the fitted model can be used to form hypotheses and investigate research questions that are costly to study with real human participants. This work contributes to debugging human understanding of XAI, informing the future development of more usable and interpretable AI explanations.

</details>


### [180] [The TEA Nets framework combines AI and cognitive network science to model targets, events and actors in text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27673)
*Sebastiano Franchini,Alexis Carrillo,Edoardo Sebastiano De Duro,Riccardo Improta,Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili,Massimo Stella*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并开源了目标-事件-主体网络（TEA Nets）：一个融合认知网络科学与 AI 的"玻璃盒"式文本分析框架，把文本中的主语（Agents）、动词（Events）、宾语（Targets）显式抽取并建为（近似）三部图，从而可解释地刻画"谁做了什么、作用于谁"，支持情绪检测、语义框架与语言学分析。框架以开源 Python 库 `teanets` 发布（github.com/MassimoStel/TEA_Networks），并通过被动语态处理（is_passive / passive_approx 标记）、核心指代消解、spaCy 句法解析与网络度量实现，配套发布 122 句人工标注基准与被动语态验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在两类关键缺口：(1) 认知网络科学中的文本形式心态网络（TFMNs）虽用 AI 句法解析捕捉主-谓、动-宾关系，但未标明概念的语法角色，无法区分"施事者、旁观者、受害者"（如"我被叔叔强奸"与"我被强奸时叔叔在旁观"中的 uncle 角色不同），也不支持跨子语料的情绪/句法/语义框架比较；(2) NLP 侧的情感词典、LIWC、词袋模型只统计表层词频，丢失关系与因果信息；BERT/LLM 等向量模型虽隐含学到施事-受事结构但机制不透明、属黑箱。作者因此需要一个既透明可解释、又能在大规模文本中重建"行为体-行为-后果"三元结构的工具，并希望将其用于阴谋论叙事、性侵叙事中的施事归属，以及人类与 LLM 心理治疗对话的机器心理学比较。

Method: 构建管线：文本清洗与核心指代消解（默认 FastCoref，可替换 Stanza）→ 基于 spaCy en_core_web_trf 的 POS 标注、依存句法分析、词形还原与命名实体识别 → SVO 三元组抽取（动词短语打包：含助动词、否定、副词及 xcomp/ccomp 从属；主语支持并列主语与从属子句继承；宾语涵盖 dobj/pobj/dative/ccomp/xcomp）→ 被动语态处理 → 建图。被动的四类独立判据：规范被动（auxpass/nsubjpass，含 get-被动）、feel-被动（VBN + 非助动/系动词助动词的白名单外辅助）、agent 短语（by-短语）、并列被动从属结点（conj 头动词为被动）；有 by-短语时把 by 宾语映射为 Agent、语法主语移为 Target，无 by-短语时保留语法主语作为近似 Agent 并置 passive_approx=1，且对被动动词禁止主语继承以防把主动祖先主语错判为施事者。网络为无向近似三部图：节点按 Agent/Event/Target 分组，边为 Agent–Event 与 Event–Target，边宽映射句法关系权重，节点颜色由 VADER 情感效价决定，同层节点间虚线边表示共指或 WordNet 同义关系，可按三元组导出超图。度量包括度 K、组内相对度 K*、词元频率 F、重复度指数 RI=F/K、边权、归一化边权 NW（跨语料可比）与边凸显度 P=NW1−NW2；辅以 Kendall τ 相关、EmoAtlas"情绪花"z 分数、NRC 情绪强度词典、Brysbaert 具体性评分与 Mann–Whitney U 检验。验证：122 句（71 主动 / 51 被动，其中 23 句含 by-施事、27 句无施事）人工标注基准对比最小依存基线抽取器；以及 PassivePy 1,150 句众包被动语态数据集。三个案例：LOCO 阴谋论语料（高代表性 4,227 篇 vs 低相似度 4,227 篇）、Reddit r/sexualassault 施事分析（10,265,474→2,270,075→315,173 行）、HOPE（212 人类）vs CounseLLMe（GPT-3.5 100 / Claude 3 Haiku 100 英文）心理治疗对话比较。

Result: 抽取验证：TEA Nets 在 122 句基准上 Agent/Event/Target 准确率分别为 0.910/0.811/0.861，显著优于基线（0.893/0.697/0.787），主要增益在 Event 与 Target；被动语态检测在 PassivePy 上宏平均准确率 0.971（被动 0.954、主动 0.975）。案例一（LOCO）：高阴谋论文本中"I/you/we"与相同动作的连接频率约为低相似度文本的两倍（RI 分别 3.9/3.1/3.9 vs 2.1/1.3/2.2），度高（you K=18.1、we 17.6、I 16.8 vs 2.6/1.8/1.1），"god"在高组居 Agent 第 16 位（K=1,642，RI=6.24）而在低组仅第 1,339 位（K=12，RI=31.33）；两组 909,184 条 Agent-Event 边仅 1.98% 重叠，"I/you/we"共享边的 Kendall τ=0.458/0.440/0.463（p<.001）；高组用 think/know/believe/do/get 等信念与行动动词，低组偏向 search/read/uncover 等信息交换及 order/download 等交易导航词；"you→people"的动作在高组诱发显著愤怒（z≈2.63）与期待（z≈2.80，超出 |z|<1.96 拒绝区），低组只有微弱正性情绪。案例二（Reddit 性侵）：主动句占 62.1%；施事中性 72.3%、男性 22.8%、女性 4.9%（约为女性 5 倍），主动句施事以代词与模糊指称（I/who/he/guy/you/she/it）为主，被动句中家庭/配偶类（brother、someone、family member、man、cousin、friend、father、guy、dad）成为最频繁施事词，提示被动化可能是有意的疏离机制。案例三（心理治疗）：在"I-feel-Target"结构中人类、Haiku、GPT 的悲伤词频均显著高于随机基线（z≈3.69/3.11/4.54），但 Haiku 的悲伤情绪强度低于人类（U=1243.5, p=.036），厌恶亦然（U=242.5, p=.042）；Haiku 还呈现显著 joy（z≈2.32）与显著降低的 anger（z≈−2.56），GPT 与人类无此现象；施事具体性方面人类中位数 3.20 显著高于 GPT 2.76 与 Haiku 2.70（p<.001），且 LLM 分布 IQR 更窄（0.93 vs 1.46），GPT 与 Haiku 之间无差异（p=.507）；"I"在三组中相对度最高（人类 .675、GPT .639、Haiku .835），"we"亦具非忽略中心性。

Conclusion: TEA Nets 将"施事-行为-后果"的显式句法结构与情绪效价整合进可解释的认知网络表示，配合网络度量（度、重复度、归一化边权、凸显度）可对大规模语料做细粒度、可解释的定量语言与心理分析：既揭示阴谋论叙事的第一/第二人称自我指涉与集体呼吁模式与"you→people"动作的愤怒/期待倾向，也能通过区分主动与被动语态揭示性侵叙事中施事归属的分布差异，并量化 LLM 模拟患者与人类在情绪强度与施事具体性上的落差（LLM 更温和、更泛化、缺乏现实验照度）。作者据此指出，LLM 虚拟患者在用作心理治疗训练的高保真替代品前需改进提示工程/微调以贴近真实情绪表达，而 TEA Nets 提供的结构化句法-语义信息正可用于指导提示设计。局限：核心指代消解精度有限（模块化设计便于替换升级）；语音转写丢失语调、韵律与讽刺线索；基于词典的 VADER 效价存在语境误判；SVO 单元难以覆盖嵌套/层级复杂句（部分可由超图缓解）；目前仅支持英语（其他 SVO 语言如斯堪的纳维亚语在原理上可扩展）。结论认为 TEA Nets 为行为与社会科学研究提供了与既有文本分析方法互补的新路径，并开启了认知网络科学文本分析的新方向。

Abstract: We introduce Target-Event-Agent Networks (TEA Nets) as a computational framework to extract subjects (``Agents"), verbs (``Events"), and objects (``Targets") from texts. Grounded in cognitive network science and artificial intelligence, TEA Nets are implemented as an open-source Python library. We test TEA Nets in three case studies, demonstrating the framework's ability to perform interpretable emotion detection, semantic frame analyses, and linguistic inquiries across conspiracy texts and textual responses generated by LLMs. In the LOCO conspiracy corpus, TEA Nets revealed that highly conspiratorial narratives (4,227 texts) linked personal pronouns (``I", ``you", ``we") with the same actions twice as frequently as low-similarity conspiracy narratives. High-conspiracy narratives connected person-focused elements (``you", ``people") through actions eliciting anger above the random baseline ($z = 2.63, p < .05$), a trend absent in low-similarity conspiracy narratives, which emphasized scientific actors (``researcher", ``scientist"). In the HOPE and CounseLLMe datasets of 212 (human) and 200 (LLM-based) psychotherapy transcripts, respectively, TEA Nets highlighted emotional differences. When expressing feelings, Claude 3 Haiku, GPT-3.5, and humans used sad words with higher frequency than random expectations but Haiku expressed sadness with lower emotional intensity than humans ($U = 1243.5, p = .036$). We discuss these differences in the context of psychotherapy training on LLM-simulated patients. Our results show that Target-Event-Agent Networks can extract relevant emotional, syntactic, and semantic insights from narratives, opening new avenues for text analysis with cognitive network science.

</details>


### [181] [Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD): A Formal Framework for Runtime Delegation Safety in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27358)
*Yuan Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD)：把 LLM 多智能体系统的"运行时任务委派安全"形式化为双层优化。外层元权重网络 φ 学习上下文相关安全–效率权衡 λ(s)∈[0,1]，内层在概率安全约束 P(safe)≥1−δ 下优化委派策略 π；连续委派度 α∈[0,1] 在"全人工接管(α=0)"与"完全自治(α=1)"之间平滑插值。论文给出三个理论结果（安全单调性、内层策略线性收敛、责任传播上界）、一套含超梯度更新的 SBD 算法，以及在医疗 MIMIC-III、金融 S&P 500、教育 ASSISTments 三个高风险领域的**预注册**评测协议（本文为 v1，尚未报告任何实验结果）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体安全研究主要停留在"设计时"：MaAS 类方法在部署前固定架构，Agent Skills/SKILL.md 等规范给出静态权限边界，DeepMind"智能 AI 委派"给出经验性建议，HILP/MCTS-Skill 等双层工作优化的对象是技能工件或二元"自主 vs 交人类"决策，均无法在执行过程中随任务风险动态调节"该把多少决策权交给子智能体"。核心诉求是：同一表面查询在低风险（如低 APACHE-II 评分）与高风险（濒临恶化）情境下应给出不同的授权量，而现有方法没有运行时的安全–效率权衡机制，也没有可证明的跨跳责任归属工具。作者自陈动机来自于 2025–2026 年生产环境中 OpenClaw、Claude Code、企业 agentic 平台大规模部署子智能体的现实压力。

Method: **问题建模**：层级系统 A0→{a1..an}；状态 s 编码上下文（生命体征/市场波动/学生知识估计）；委派策略 π: T×S→Δ(A×[0,1])，同时输出子智能体与连续委派度 α；安全约束集 C⊆S×A×[0,1] 为给定（医疗含禁忌与急危度上限，金融含集中度与波动率上限，教育含难度差与弱势学生保护）；定义安全损失 L_safety=E[1−1_safe]、效率损失 L_eff=E[C(τ,a,α)]。

**双层结构**：外层 min_φ E_s[λ_φ(s)L_safety(π*_φ)+(1−λ_φ(s))L_eff(π*_φ)]；内层 min_π 同型加权目标，s.t. P(safe)(π,s)≥1−δ ∀s。用概率约束而非硬约束（因子智能体能力不完美，硬约束常不可行），δ=0.05 为默认风险容忍度。

**算法（Algorithm 1）**：内层 T_in=50 步投影梯度（对 α 做 min(α, α_max(s)) 裁剪式投影，如高危区 APACHE-II>20 时 α_max=ᾱ_icu）；外层用 Lorraine et al. (2020) 的近似隐式微分（higher 库，截断展开）算超梯度更新 φ，不改动任何 LLM 权重。φ/π 为 3–4 层 MLP（宽 256），η_out=1e-3，η_in=5e-4，B=256，A100 单卡每外层步约 0.8s、每次完整运行 <7 分钟。

**责任传播**：多跳链上定义 accountability 权重 w_j=(∏_{ℓ≤j}α_{i_ℓ})(1−α_{i_{j+1}})，w_k=∏α，Lemma 3.6 称其和为 1；Prop 4.8 给出 max_j w_j ≤ 1−(1−ᾱ)^k，k→∞ 时上界趋近 1 但有限链下严格小于 1。

**评测协议（预注册）**：5 个基线（Fixed-α=0.5、CPO、MARL-vanilla、MaAS、SBD-NoOuter）、指标（SR、TE、SEA 帕累托面积、AE 问责熵）、4 项可证伪判据 F1–F4、4 组消融、理论验证（λ 扫描 Spearman>0.9、线性收敛拟合 R²>0.95、1 万条随机链零违例）、以及每域 2 条具体假设（如医疗域 λ 与 APACHE-II 正相关 p<0.01，金融域 COVID 窗口 λ 比 2018 基线高 ≥0.15 且 Cohen's d>0.8）。

Result: 理论层面：(1) Thm 4.4 安全单调性——若逐点 λ_φ(s)≤λ_φ'(s)，则内层最优策略的 P(safe) 逐点单调不减，即外层提高安全权重必然产出更安全的内层策略，Corollary 4.5 进一步声称外层学到 λ 随上下文风险升高而升高，形成"风险↑→λ↑→α↓→暴露↓"闭环；(2) Thm 4.6 内层收敛——在 L-光滑、μ-强凸、可行集 Π_δ 凸的前提下，PGD 以 (1−ημ)^t 线性收敛，达到 ε 精度需 t≥(L/μ)log(‖π0−π*‖²/ε)；(3) Prop 4.8 问责传播上界（及 Corollary 4.9：责任随链变长愈发弥散但永不集中于单一智能体）。附录给出 Danskin 定理推导的 Thm 4.4 详细证明。

但需注意若干实质性缺口：① Thm 4.4 的证明循环——Assumption 4.3（内层最优处 L_safety 随 λ 非增）几乎就是结论本身，Danskin 只给出最优值随 λ 非减，无法直接推出安全分量的单调性；② 外层目标 L_meta 作为 λ 的凸组合存在退化最优解（若 L_safety<L_eff 则 λ*=1 平凡最优），Corollary 4.5 的"风险自适应 λ"并非由所写目标自动导出；③ 安全损失由 0/1 指示函数构成，分段常值、光滑性与强凸性假设难以成立，且"投影"仅是 α 裁剪，并不一般性保证 P(safe)≥1−δ；④ Lemma 3.6 的求和按其公式实际望远镜相消得 α_{i_1} 而非 1，分母/索引存在错位，权重归一性质按字面不成立；⑤ 无任何实证结果，Remark 4.7 与 §5.5 的"经验收敛"与计时断言属未验证陈述；⑥ 大量 2026 年引用文献的可核验性存疑。

Conclusion: SBD 的定位是"运行时治理"而非"设计时治理"：设计时治理针对预期上下文，运行时治理随实际执行上下文调整授权，其价值随智能体系统复杂度与运行时长上升而增大。作者认为安全单调性定理是概念内核——外层安全权重提升可证明地提升内层安全概率，构成"风险上升自动收紧安全"的闭环，这是相对静态约束方法的根本区别；问责传播上界则为多智能体事故的责任归属与 AI 治理/责任框架提供了形式化工具。局限包括：强凸假设在深度网络下不成立（未来改用 PL 条件）、安全约束集 C 需专家给定且可能不完备、仅在委派决策层保证安全而不覆盖子智能体内部执行安全、假设任务分布平稳。后续方向为组合式 SBD（递归应用于多层层级）、与 Skill 编译/技能选择置信度的桥接、对抗性 Skill 注入检测、以及以 α 阈值作为人工复核路由接口的 HITL 集成。总体而言，本文是一篇"框架+理论+预注册计划"的 v1 稿件：问题定位清晰、与 HILA/LDP/AgentCollab 等并行工作的差异化论述较完整，但核心定理证明存在循环论证与代数错误，缺失实证验证，因此其结论应被视为待检验的假设而非已确立的证据。

Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents are deployed in high-stakes environments, the question of how safely to delegate subtasks to specialized sub-agents becomes critical. Existing work addresses multi-agent architecture selection at design time or provides broad empirical guidelines, but neither provides a runtime mechanism that dynamically adjusts the safety-efficiency trade-off as task context changes during execution.
  We propose Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD), a formal framework for runtime delegation safety in hierarchical multi-agent systems. SBD formulates task delegation as a bilevel optimization problem: an outer meta-weight network phi learns context-dependent safety-efficiency weights lambda(s) in [0,1]; an inner loop optimizes the delegation policy pi subject to a probabilistic safety constraint P(safe) >= 1-delta. The continuous delegation degree alpha in [0, 1] controls how much decision authority is transferred to each sub-agent, interpolating smoothly between full human override (alpha=0) and fully autonomous execution (alpha=1).
  We establish three theoretical results: (1) Safety Monotonicity--higher outer safety weight produces a weakly safer inner policy; (2) Inner Policy Convergence--projected gradient descent on the inner problem converges linearly under standard smoothness assumptions; (3) an Accountability Propagation bound that distributes responsibility across multi-hop delegation chains with a provable per-agent ceiling. We instantiate SBD in three high-stakes domains--medical AI (MIMIC-III), financial risk control (S and P 500), and educational agent supervision (ASSISTments)--specifying datasets, safety constraint sets, baselines, and evaluation protocols. This manuscript presents the formal framework and theoretical results in full; empirical validation following the protocols described herein is planned and will be reported in a forthcoming revision.

</details>


### [182] [TIO-SHACL: Comprehensive SHACL validation for TMF Intent Ontologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27359)
*Jean Martins,Leonid Mokrushin,Marin Orlic*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 tio-shacl——首个面向 TM Forum Intent Ontology (TIO) v3.6.0 的综合性 SHACL 验证框架，将原本只由自然语言/OWL 语义描述的意图本体规范形式化为可执行的结构与语义约束：覆盖全部 15 个本体模块，提供 56 个 node shapes、69 个 property shapes 与 147 个约束实例，并构建包含 25 个参数化 SPARQL 约束组件与 3 种自定义 target type 的可复用约束库。框架采用"扩展 mixin + 参数化约束 + 正向白名单校验"三项关键设计决策（不修改 TIO 基线），以 133 条有效/无效用例构成的测试语料驱动开发，并在三种主流 SHACL 引擎上验证兼容性与准确率（Apache Jena 仅支持 SPARQL 层，不支持自定义 target type 与约束组件）。成果以 MIT 许可开源发布，使网络意图可在进入意图处理器前完成自动化语法+语义校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信网络正走向自治网络（自配置、自优化、自愈），意图式网络（IBN）允许运维人员以"确保视频业务 99.99% 可用性"这类高层目标代替逐设备配置。TM Forum 制定的 Intent Ontology (TIO) 提供了表达与上报网络意图的标准词汇（v3.6.0 共 15 个模块、87 个类、109 个属性、70+ 函数），但存在关键缺口：缺乏任何形式化验证机制。具体后果有三：(1) 语法合法但违背 TIO 语义的 RDF 会被意图处理器静默接受；(2) 跨厂商的意图可移植性无法保证；(3) TIO 自身的递归逻辑运算符（log:allOf/anyOf）、数量表达式（带单位比较）与有效性约束构成了陡峭的学习门槛，阻碍快速采纳。同时 TMF 技术报告（TR290–TR294 系列）中大量隐含约束未被编码进本体，也需要被形式化。SHACL 作为 W3C 推荐的 RDF 图验证标准，正适合承担"意图准入门禁"的角色，但此前没有面向 TIO 的完整形式化实现。

Method: 采用五阶段迭代式 shape 开发流程：(1) 本体分析——从 15 个模块的规范性 Turtle 文件中系统抽取类、属性、domain/range 与基数限制；(2) 规范挖掘——分析 TR290–TR294 系列报告，识别本体未形式化的隐含约束（如 Condition 必须出现在 Expectation 内部而非直接挂在 Intent 上）；(3) Shape 编写——每类一个 NodeShape，内嵌 PropertyShape；(4) 约束抽取——将共性逻辑提炼为参数化 SPARQL 查询库；(5) 测试驱动精修——用有效/故意无效样例迭代消除假阳性与假阴性。三项关键设计决策：① Mixin 扩展——通过 rdfs:subClassOf 在独立文件中新增 fun:BooleanFunction（resultType 为 xsd:boolean）、fun:Evaluable（可参与布尔逻辑）、fun:Actionable（必须承载布尔计算，必须为 Evaluable 子类）、icm:IntentOperand、icm:ExpectationOperand 等分类，保持 TIO 基线原样以便未来版本干净合并；② 参数化约束——单一 FunctionUsageArityConstraint 通过 RDF 列表元素计数校验全部 72+ 函数的元数，新增函数只需实例化参数；③ 正向校验（白名单 opt-in）替代"禁止类型"黑名单，符合开闭原则。三类新验证模式：递归逻辑运算符的模式展开与操作数类型核验、数量型带单位比较（如 quan:atLeast/met:lastValue 的结果类型经 rdfs:range 多态推断链）、跨 Expectation 的有效性继承。遵循"完整性、模块化、标准合规、消息可行动性"四项原则，限于 SHACL-Core 与 SHACL-SPARQL 特性，并大量使用 SHACL-AF 的 sh:SPARQLTargetType 与 sh:ConstraintComponent。

Result: 验证维度包括三方面：(1) 词汇覆盖——目标 100% 覆盖 TIO v3.6.0 的 87 个类、109 个属性与 72 个函数，全部映射到形状与约束；(2) 跨实现兼容性——在三种主流 SHACL 引擎上测试，发现 Apache Jena 仅支持 SPARQL 层、不支持自定义 target type 与 constraint component，构成实际部署约束，因此框架内建降级/兼容策略；(3) 验证准确性——在 133 条测试用例（有效与无效意图均衡配比）语料上评估，作为正确性基准同时充当本体演进的回归安全网：新版 TIO 引入新类/属性或修订语义时，失败用例会直接指出需更新的形状，并确认未受影响模块仍然正确，从而显著降低适配成本。文中给出的"Validation by Example"演示了语义级错误捕获：删除 dim:Throughput 的 a met:Metric 与 rdfs:range quan:Quantity 声明后，RDF 仍语法合法，但一次缺失声明级联产生两条 sh:Violation（met:lastValue 期望 met:Metric；quan:AtLeast 期望 quan:Quantity），证明 SHACL 可将"结构正确但语义错误"的意图拦截。缺失 log:allOf 的 Intent 被 tio:ActionableBooleanEvaluableConstraint 报出"missing BooleanFunction property"并给出修正提示；缺 Expectation 包装导致 log:Condition 不属于 icm:IntentOperand 而触发层级违规。所有形状、测试用例与工具链以 MIT 许可公开于 github.com/EricssonResearch/tio-shacl。（注：所提供正文在第 4/5 节处截断，故精确的覆盖率数值、引擎名称与准确率百分比未在文本中给出。）

Conclusion: tio-shacl 填补了 TIO 领域"意图准入门禁"的关键空白：把原本依赖人工阅读 TMF 技术报告的隐式语义约束，转化为机器可执行、可复现、可版本化的 SHACL 形状库，实现网络意图的自动化语法与语义双重校验，并支撑意图跨厂商可移植性。其学术与工程意义体现在三点：首次实现 TIO v3.6.0 的完整 SHACL 形式化（覆盖 15 模块全部词汇）；提出可迁移的 SHACL-AF 工程范式（参数化约束组件、自定义 target type、不改基线的 mixin 扩展、正向白名单校验），可复用于其他复杂工业本体；并以测试驱动方法论把形状库变成可持续演进的资产——133 条用例同时作为正确性基准与回归测试网，验证了面向未来 TIO 版本的向后兼容性。局限方面，SHACL-AF 在不同引擎支持度不一致（Apache Jena 能力受限），且复杂递归逻辑与多态结果类型推断的完整覆盖仍依赖 SPARQL 层面的定制逻辑。

Abstract: Intent-based networking promises to revolutionize telecommunications network management by enabling operators to specify high-level goals rather than low-level configurations. The TM Forum Intent Ontology (tio) provides a standardized vocabulary for expressing network intents, yet lacks formal validation mechanisms to ensure intent correctness before its admission. We present tio-shacl, the first comprehensive SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) validation framework for the TMF Intent Ontology. Our contribution includes 56 node shapes and 69 property shapes across all 15 tio v3.6.0 ontology modules, a reusable constraint library with 25 parameterized SPARQL-based constraint components, and novel validation patterns for recursive logical operators, quantity-based constraints, and cross-expectation relationships. We pursued 100% vocabulary coverage (87 classes, 109 properties, 72 functions), cross-implementation compatibility across three major SHACL engines, and validation accuracy on a corpus of 133 test cases. tio-shacl is publicly available under MIT license at https://github.com/EricssonResearch/tio-shacl and enables automated syntactic and semantic validation of network intents, addressing a critical gap in the field.

</details>


### [183] [Measurement Risk in Supervised Financial NLP: Rubric and Metric Sensitivity on JF-ICR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27374)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu,Yuxiao Chen,Rongdong Chai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了金融NLP基准评估中的测量风险，发现rubric措辞对模型标签分配有显著影响，并非所有评估指标在特定类别分布下都具备信息性，排序结果的可辩护性需以指标可辨识性审计为前提。核心贡献在于提出了针对监督式金融基准的报告规范，而非新的排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在财报电话会议、投资者问答、业绩指引和披露文本等金融场景中的应用日益广泛，监督式金融NLP基准正成为模型选择和部署的关键决策依据。然而存在一个隐含假设——gold标签使基准评估具有客观性。当基准评估工具本身对评分标准措辞、指标选择或聚合策略敏感时，这一假设便不再成立。

Method: 研究采用JF-ICR数据集（253项固定测试集），在4个前沿LLM、5种评分标准、3种温度设置、5种序数指标条件下进行实验，考察不同rubric措辞对模型标签分配的影响。实验还使用Bradley-Terry、Borda和Ranked Pairs三种排序方法进行指标可辨识性审计。

Result: 三项主要发现：1）rubric措辞显著影响模型标签分配，R2-R3一致率在70.0%至83.4%之间波动，变化主要集中在+1/0隐含承诺边界附近，符合语用边界解释但因rubric变体混淆语义、示例和详略程度而未经语言因果性验证；2）并非所有指标在JF-ICR类别分布下都保持信息性，within-one准确率因少数接近误判得满分且多数类主导而过于简单，worst-class准确率因最稀有类仅有2个样本而过于嘈杂，identifiable指标为exact accuracy、macro-F1和weighted κ；3）排序声明仅在指标可辨识性审计后才更具辩护性，三种排序方法在identifiable指标子集上达成一致，而完整五指标扫描对最近似对的排序产生分歧。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献不是提出新的排行榜，而是一种针对监督式金融NLP基准的报告规范制定方法，强调在gold标签存在的情况下，评估标尺本身仍需要治理。研究成果为金融NLP领域提供了系统性的基准测量风险管理框架，具有重要的方法论意义。

Abstract: As LLMs become credible readers of earnings calls, investor-relations Q\&A, guidance, and disclosure language, supervised financial NLP benchmarks increasingly function as decision evidence for model selection and deployment. A hidden assumption is that gold labels make such evidence objective. This assumption breaks down when the benchmark ruler itself is sensitive to rubric wording, metric choice, or aggregation policy. We study this measurement risk on Japanese Financial Implicit-Commitment Recognition (JF-ICR; a pinned 253-item test split x 4 frontier LLMs x 5 rubrics x 3 temperatures x 5 ordinal metrics). Three findings follow. First, rubric wording materially changes model-assigned labels: R2--R3 agreement ranges from 70.0% to 83.4%, with the dominant movement near the +1 / 0 implicit-commitment boundary. This pattern is consistent with a pragmatic-boundary interpretation, but is not a validated linguistic-causality claim because the present rubric variants confound semantics, examples, and verbosity. Second, not every metric remains informative under the JF-ICR class distribution. Within-one accuracy is too easy because near misses receive credit and the majority class dominates; worst-class accuracy is too noisy because the rarest class has only two examples. Exact accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted \k{appa} are therefore the identifiable metrics under our operational rule. Third, ranking claims become more defensible only after this metric-identifiability audit: Bradley--Terry, Borda, and Ranked Pairs agree on the identifiable metric subset, while the full five-metric sweep produces disagreement on the closest pair. The contribution is not a new leaderboard, but a reporting discipline for supervised financial benchmarks whose gold labels exist and whose evaluation ruler still requires governance.

</details>


### [184] [Robust Learning on Heterogeneous Graphs with Heterophily: A Graph Structure Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27387)
*Yihan Zhang,Ercan E. Kuruoglu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对异构图中结构噪声导致的性能退化问题，提出统一的HGUL框架，通过kNN邻域恢复、噪声边过滤和多项式图核亲和力学习三个模块协同处理异源性和噪声。实验验证了该方法在干净图和噪声环境下均具有优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构图中节点具有不同类型和标签，其交互模式多样且常呈非齐次性分布。现有的异构图表示学习方法缺乏对结构噪声的鲁棒性处理，而结构噪声会显著降低模型性能，这一关键挑战尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 提出HGUL统一框架，包含三个互补模块：1) 基于kNN的图构建模块，恢复可靠的局部邻域；2) 图结构学习模块，通过过滤噪声边自适应细化邻接矩阵；3) 异构亲和力学习模块，通过多项式图核推导的扩展亲和力矩阵捕捉类级关系。

Result: 在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，HGUL在干净图上始终优于现有方法，并在不同强度的结构噪声下保持较强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 实验结果强调了异构图学习中协同建模异源性和噪声的重要性，为处理复杂异构图的鲁棒表示学习提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Heterogeneous graphs with heterophily have emerged as a powerful abstraction for modeling complex real-world systems, where nodes of different types and labels interact in diverse and often non-homophilous ways. Despite recent advances, robust representation learning for such graphs remains largely unexplored, particularly in the presence of noisy or misleading connectivity. In this work, we investigate this problem and identify structural noise as a critical challenge that significantly degrades model performance. To address this issue, we propose a unified framework, Heterogeneous Graph Unified Learning (HGUL), which jointly handles heterophily and noisy graph structures. The framework consists of three complementary modules: a kNN-based graph construction module that recovers reliable local neighborhoods, a graph structure learning module that adaptively refines the adjacency by filtering noisy edges, and a heterogeneous affinity learning module that captures class-level relationships via an extended affinity matrix derived from a polynomial graph kernel. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that HGUL consistently outperforms existing methods on clean graphs and maintains strong robustness under varying levels of structural noise. The results further underscore the importance of jointly modeling heterophily and noise in heterogeneous graph learning.

</details>


### [185] [Mapping the Methodological Space of Classroom Interaction Research: Scale, Duration, and Modality in an Age of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28098)
*Dorottya Demszky,Edith Bouton,Alison Twiner,Sara Hennessy,Richard Correnti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个三维方法论框架（规模、时长、模态），用于整合课堂互动研究中的大规模观察与深度民族志研究方法。通过对比两项对话式教学研究并访谈主要研究者，框架阐明了不同研究定位如何影响可揭示与隐藏的内容，并探讨了AI技术对该研究空间的拓展作用及其对研究与工具设计的指导意义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 课堂互动研究长期分裂为大规模观察与深度民族志研究两大阵营，两种方法各有优劣但缺乏系统性整合

Method: 通过三个维度（规模、时长、模态）构建方法论空间框架；对比两项关于对话式教学的研究（Howe等人2019年研究和Snell与Lefstein 2018年研究）；对主要研究者进行访谈

Result: 框架可揭示研究"能操作化什么"、"什么机制可见"、"什么能转化到实践"三个关键问题；同时探讨AI如何扩展此方法论空间

Conclusion: 提出了一个用于指导课堂互动研究设计和工具开发的三维方法论框架

Abstract: Research on classroom interaction has long been divided between large-scale observation and in-depth ethnographic work. We propose a framework mapping this methodological space along three dimensions--scale, duration, and modality--where a study's position shapes what it reveals and obscures. We illustrate it through contrasting studies of dialogic teaching--Howe et al. (2019) and Snell and Lefstein (2018)--and an interview with the lead researchers, organized around three questions: what can be operationalized, what mechanisms become visible, and what translates to practice. We then examine how AI is expanding this space and how the framework can guide research and tool design.

</details>


### [186] [Normativity and Productivism: Ableist Intelligence? A Degrowth Analysis of AI Sign Language Translation Tools for Deaf People](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28125)
*Nina Seron-Abouelfadil,Poppy Fynes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper critiques AI systems for sign language as "Ableist Intelligence" that colonizes deaf communication through standardization and rationalization, imposing hearing-centric norms while eliminating the authentic human experience and cultural richness of sign languages.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: To critique AI-based sign language recognition and interpretation systems that are built without deaf community input, relying on biased data, and operating under the assumption that such technologies serve the hearing majority while failing to understand or preserve the inherent culture, semantics, and colloquial nature of sign languages.

Method: The paper applies Ellul's sociological theories of The Technological System and Technological bluff to analyze how AI systems for sign language transform gestural communication into quantified, data-driven formats, thereby standardizing and rationalizing sign language into what can be captured by technical metrics.

Result: The analysis reveals that AI technique standardizes sign language into data and statistics, annihilating the conditions for authentic communication and the human experience of deaf individuals. This creates normative effects producing a "standardized, massified" model of humanity that must adapt to the tool rather than vice versa, resulting in counter-productivity: alienation instead of emancipation, isolation instead of connection.

Conclusion: AI systems for sign language represent "Ableist Intelligence" that reinforces the marginalization of deaf communities by imposing standardized, hearing-centric norms rather than accommodating the authentic human experience of sign language users.

Abstract: Sign languages, of any geographical or accentual variation, understandably face continuous scrutiny under the ever present popularity of verbal dictation and audism. Through this, many potential problems arise with the current lack of accessible communication for those who rely on such sign languages for essential conversation. Such AI systems regularly take the form of recognition and interpretation models, designed to provide seamless and accurate translation. In reality these systems are built from biased data and created without any input from deaf communities. Such models are widely used and accepted by their hearing counterparts who remain ignorant to the inherent culture, semantics and colloquial language present in gestural language systems.
  This phenomenon is best analysed under the scope of The Technological System and Technological bluff by Ellul. Indeed, what is at play here is the standardization of language by technicians into what can be captured by technique: data, statistics, a mathematical language. For that AI technique to exist, sign language must be rationalized, in a search for profit that annihilates the conditions for communication and fails to capture the human experience of the deaf person. By that process, it presents normative effects, creating a model of Man, standardized, massified, and who has to adapt to the tool and technical milieu instead of the other way around, which we assume should have been the goal of such a technology.
  Technique thus reshapes what it means to be human, to submit deaf people to the goals of productivity and efficiency. In doing so, it exhibits clear counter productivity, alienating instead of emancipating, isolating instead of nourishing human relationships. Therefore this paper argues for the idea of AI as Ableist Intelligence, as such systems seek to emphasise the humiliated and marginalised nature of sign.

</details>


### [187] [A Pattern Language for Resilient Visual Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28001)
*Habtom Kahsay Gidey,Alexander Lenz,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向"视觉智能体"的架构模式语言（Pattern Language），用于在企业级 GUI 自动化中调和"端到端 VLA 模型的语义理解能力"与"企业控制回路所需的确定性、实时性"之间的矛盾。核心思路是把语义缺口重构为 Sim2Real 缺口，用分层架构将"快而确定的反射层（System 1）"与"慢而概率性的认知/监督层（System 2，含 VLA 监督器与语义世界模型）"解耦，并通过三个异步控制回路（Reflex / Structural / Supervisor）实现摊销式推理（amortized inference）：昂贵的语义推理只在感知失败或 UI 漂移时被调用，用于修复廉价的本地反射。四个架构模式为：混合可供性集成、适应性视觉锚定、视觉层级综合、语义场景图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业环境（遗留 ERP、专家系统、气隙隔离系统、虚拟桌面/远程桌面如 VNC/Citrix）缺乏可用的 API、DOM 结构或稳定自动化钩子，智能体只能依靠视觉感知与 GUI 交互来自动化长程、认知负荷高的任务。现有两类方案各有致命缺陷：传统 RPA/脚本高效、可审计、确定性强，但依赖脆弱的结构化定位器与静态屏幕坐标，轻微 UI 更新（布局偏移、分辨率变化、意外弹窗）即导致开环失败；端到端 VLA 模型（UI-TARS、CogAgent）具备语义理解与适应性，却带来高延迟（每个原子动作数秒，含网络往返可达约 10s）、推理成本、非确定性以及架构纠缠（单体模型缺乏模块化、正交性与隔离，形成 CACE 反模式与技术债务，修改或微调有灾难性遗忘风险），不适配企业实时控制回路。由此形成"双峰失败模式"（bimodal failure pattern）：架构师被迫在实时控制与语义适应性之间取舍。作者主张这不是模型选型问题而是根本的软件架构问题——如何在异构、冲突质量属性（确定性低延迟控制 vs. 概率性高延迟语义推理）之间进行分解、责任分配、显式协调与权衡（延迟、可靠性、可解释性、成本）。

Method: 1) 理论综合：融合生态学视觉感知（active perception）、Kahneman 的 System 1/System 2 双过程理论、行为机器人学的分层 subsumption 架构（Brooks）与自计算 MAPE-K 自愈控制回路，将智能体建模为具身智能体而非脚本，赋予其视觉本体感觉（通过光流验证动作，如"按钮是否被按下"）、主动感知（滚动等认知性动作消解不确定性）与分层控制能力。
2) 架构forces分析：提出时间（延迟 vs 语义）、成本（推理开销 vs 能力）、可靠性（确定性 vs 适应性）、可解释性（感知失败 vs 逻辑失败的诊断与故障隔离）四类冲突力量，每类给出对应的架构驱动要求。
3) 模式语言形式化：采用经典模式文档格式（Context / Problem / Solution），在"上下文—问题—解决方案"中显式标注所应对的架构 forces，定义四个模式的结构职责、协调边界与通信规则，并综合为含三个异步控制回路（Reflex、Structural、Supervisor）的参考架构。
4) 评估方法：采用基于场景的架构分析法（SAAM），构造"典型遗留场景"——非仪表化金融 ERP（如 DATEV）与 MS Access 界面上的高频"发票审批"批处理（校验字段并点击 Submit），注入 UI 漂移压力事件（Submit 按钮右移 50 像素、样式由蓝变绿、且在原坐标处出现危险的 Delete/Cancel 按钮）；质量目标为绝对安全（绝不点击 Delete）与每条记录延迟 <1s。对比三个方案：Baseline A 经典 RPA（开环 click(x,y)，误删记录，安全失败）、Baseline B 端到端 VLA（识别正确但约 10s/次，1000 条发票额外近 3 小时，违反延迟与成本）、所提架构（锚点匹配置信度跌破阈值 τ<0.9 即抑制点击，触发 VLA 监督器语义定位新绿色按钮并更新模板缓存与坐标，随后 999 条以毫秒级完成）。
5) 经济性建模：给出摊销成本公式 Cost_avg = Cost_Reflex + (P_Drift × Cost_Supervisor)，其中 P_Drift 为 UI 扰动/布局偏移概率（示例 1%），说明当漂移概率低时平均运行开销趋近于零。

Result: 1) 提出包含四个架构设计模式的模式语言：混合可供性集成（并行 UI 对象检测 + OCR → 几何融合 → 冲突时下调置信度并标记"不确定"，触发悬停等主动验证，作为架构的数据清洗过滤器，仅向下游世界模型写入多源验证实体）；适应性视觉锚定（以回退路由连接器建立 System 1 本地缓存/模板/特征嵌入（<50ms）与 System 2 VLA 监督器之间的边界与交接契约；匹配置信度低于 τ<0.9 时停止执行而非猜测，监督器语义定位并回写缓存，即"漂移异常"机制）；视觉层级综合（结构中介层，基于 Gestalt 的包含与对齐分组规则将扁平感知输出聚合为 UI 树形结构，支持 click("Submit","Login_Form") 式相对寻址，对平移不变）；语义场景图（节点为语义实体、边为功能关系与空间约束，构成显式可查询世界模型，执行高风险计划前遍历图以验证前置条件并显式识别安全违规）。
2) SAAM 场景走查结果：经典 RPA 在漂移下触发 Delete 陷阱造成灾难性失败；端到端 VLA 语义正确但约 10s 往返、1000 条批量额外近 3 小时，违反延迟与成本目标；所提架构通过"反射失败→监督修复→模板缓存更新"完成自愈，后续 999 条以毫秒级反射执行，满足安全与 <1s/记录 的延迟目标。
3) 摊销成本分析表明，在 P_Drift 约 1%、反射成本与延迟可忽略（<50ms）的条件下，即使监督器单次约 10s 并产生 API 费用，平均运行开销仍趋近于零，论证了高频批处理场景下的经济可行性。
4) 明确指出该场景图有助于缓解概率模型的"测试悖论"，可支撑语义契约测试（semantic contract testing）。
