Method: 理论部分：定义"流形的加性混合"（Additive Mixture of Manifolds，Defn. 2，x = Σ_i f_i(m_i)，各流形嵌入于低维仿射子空间并可加性叠加；当流形退化为射线时即退化为 LRH）；定义"子空间捕获"（Defn. 3：存在 |S*|≤k_M 的原子组，其张成子空间包含整条流形且在流形每个输入上被一致选中）；定理 1/2（子空间恢复）：在字典 μ-不相干、μ<1/(2k−1)（即 Tropp 的 ERC 条件）、且 SAE 在流形上重建误差 ≤λ 时，理想稀疏解码器可 O(λ) 精度捕获流形（借助 OMP/BP 与噪声零空间性质，并讨论了理想解码器与训练编码器之间的摊销差距）；由此区分三种机制：捕获（capture）、打碎（shattering，平铺且支持集近乎互斥）、稀释（dilution，平铺但支持集高度重叠、耦合符号混杂）。附录进一步提出"稀疏概念的几何对偶"（Defn. 4）：方向式（概念为方向，重建落在稀疏非负锥/可加）与点式（概念为点，重建落在稀疏凸包/单纯形约束）；对点式给出"单纯形捕获"（Defn. 5，Hausdorff 距离与 Vietoris–Rips 拓扑恢复）并证明引理 1：点式 landmark 无法分解因子流形（其凸包不等于 Minkowski 和），故方向式 SAE 在叠加下因子级分析才是良定的。统计部分：用二元 Ising 模型 p(s) ∝ exp(Σ J_ij s_i s_j + Σ h_i s_i) 对二值化 SAE 编码建模共激活（似然用伪似然 PLM+L-BFGS 拟合，EBIC 正则，J 强制对称），由 Besag/Hammersley-Clifford 性质，J 的零结构等价于条件独立图，可区分"结构共激活"与"数据相关性"；再对 |J| 做 Louvain 社区发现并用 PCA 谱隙校验。实证部分：（1）构造 8 类流形（圆、球、环面、莫比乌斯带、Swiss roll、螺旋、扁盘、线段）× 6 组参数 = 48 个实例，等距归一化、随机正交嵌入 R^128、稀疏混合采样，训练 TopK SAE（c=512，k∈{3,…,25}）；（2）Llama3.1-8B layer-19 残差流（d=4096）上训练五种架构 SAE（5 亿 token The Pile，扩张 ×8/×16，稀疏度 64/128/256），仅保留 VE>0.85 者；度量包括 restricted R²（按解码方向贪心选原子并掩码解码）、支持集大小、感受野离散度、调谐曲线、接收野空间着色图；（3）沿流形主成分做激活 patching 插值以验证因果性；（4）对比 5 种特征亲和度度量（解码余弦、条件共激活、Pearson、PMI、Ising 耦合）并做无监督流形发现。

Result: 1) 流形普遍存在且有因果效力：Llama3.1-8B 中颜色（抛物面/环向色相）、星期（圆）、温度、年龄、年份（螺旋）、地理（层级树）等在 PCA 下呈平滑弯曲几何，且沿流形质心插值 steering 会使相关目标 token 概率平滑变化。2) 合成实验揭示稀疏度"甜点"：捕获质量在 k≈4（接近流形嵌入维数）附近最高，过低则原子被广泛共享而流形被打碎，过高则大量冗余原子同时激活、特征丧失特异性；随 k 增大依次经过 shattering → capture → dilution 三相。3) 真实 LLM 上现有 SAE 均未实现紧凑捕获：restricted R² 随支持集增大持续上升但在远超过流形环境维数处才饱和，说明几何被稀释到大量部分冗余的特征上，属稀释态。4) 特征以局部检测器方式平铺流形：单个特征只重构流形的局部块，随特征数增加呈分段线性逼近；调谐曲线显示局部、平滑、重叠的激活（"年份"流形上多数 SAE 学到"个位数年份"每 10 年周期激活的特征及编码年代的特征），类似神经科学中的群体编码调谐曲线。5) 度量比较中 Ising 耦合与条件共激活给出最清晰的块对角结构，解码余弦与 Pearson 相关失败——说明流形归属是功能属性（谁共激活）而非几何属性（指向何处）；纯方向相关性不足以发现流形。6) 无监督管线成功恢复温度、颜色、政治倾向等监督可见流形，并发现此前未知的新流形（科学语境中的认知不确定性/测量误差）。7) 该视角统一解释了既有负面结论：等价基/等价平铺导致特征跨训练不稳定；特征是局部方向，故单特征 steering 把表征推离流形而非沿流形移动；只有特征组整体才有意义。附录还显示不同 SAE 的单特征对齐很差，但同一流形上的诱导坐标系高度一致，说明被保留的是几何结构而非特征本身。

Conclusion: SAE 在原理上可以捕获流形，但在实践中以碎片化方式捕获：流形并未被组织成连贯子空间，而是平铺到大量局部、部分冗余的特征上，导致几何只被隐式保留、单特征层面不可读，方向式可解释性因而受限。论文主张可解释性的基本单位应从"单个方向/原子"转向"几何对象"，具体包括：(i) 设计显式以流形为原语的新型 featurizer（现有特征化器仍是一维原子、重建损失不奖励几何一致性，是根本错配）；(ii) 发展以特征组为单位的分析/操纵工具。作者坦承现状限制：混合选择性特征使共激活信号受扰、基于 Ising 耦合的分组质量受限于底层平铺质量，因此事后分析只是权宜之计而非解决方案；点式（凸包/单纯形）SAE 在加性叠加下存在原理性障碍，若要恢复因子流形需改用 Minkowski 和或分块单纯形等组合式构造。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to extract interpretable features from neural network representations, often under the implicit assumption that concepts correspond to independent linear directions. However, a growing body of evidence suggests that many concepts are instead organized along low-dimensional manifolds encoding continuous geometric relationships. This raises three basic questions: what does it mean for an SAE to capture a manifold, when do existing SAE architectures do so, and how? We develop a theoretical framework that answers these questions and show that SAEs can capture manifolds in two fundamentally different ways: globally, by allocating a compact group of atoms whose linear span contains the entire manifold, or locally, by distributing it across features that each selectively tile a restricted region of the underlying geometry. Empirically, we find that SAEs suboptimally recover continuous structures, mixing the global subspace and local tiling solutions in a fragmented regime we call dilution. This explains why manifold structure is rarely visible at the level of individual concepts and motivates post-hoc unsupervised discovery methods that search for coherent groups of atoms rather than isolated directions. More broadly, our results suggest that future representation learning methods should treat geometric objects, not just individual directions, as the basic units of interpretability.

</details>


### [323] [Global Optimality for Constrained Exploration via Penalty Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28144)
*Florian Wolf,Ilyas Fatkhullin,Niao He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对约束最大熵探索问题提出PGP方法，通过二次惩罚正则化在策略空间直接优化，利用隐藏凸性和强对偶性证明全局收敛，实现ε-最优和约束满足，是首个在一般策略参数化下能输出单一可部署近优策略的无模型策略梯度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界的探索往往受安全、资源或模仿需求的约束，而无约束最大熵探索已被相对充分理解。这种约束设置具有挑战性，因为熵最大化缺乏加性结构，导致基于Bellman方程的方法不适用，且可扩展方法需要策略参数化，在目标和约束中都会引入非凸性。现有方法仅能保证弱遗憾和遍历平均，无法输出单一可部署的近优、近可行策略。

Method: 提出Policy Gradient Penalty (PGP)方法，一种单循环策略空间方法，通过二次惩罚正则化来施加一般凸 occupancy-measure 约束。该方法构造伪奖励以获得惩罚目标的梯度估计，然后利用经典策略梯度定理进行优化。文中建立了惩罚目标的正则性，给出了收敛所需的平滑性质，并利用隐藏凸性和强对偶性建立了全局收敛保证。

Result: 在一般策略参数化下，PGP实现了全局最后迭代收敛，达到ε-最优约束熵值且具有有界约束违反，证明了尽管存在策略诱导的非凸性，方法仍能收敛到最优解。

Conclusion: 提出PGP方法在约束最大熵探索问题上取得了突破性进展，通过二次惩罚正则化和隐藏凸性分析，首次在一般策略参数化下实现了全局收敛且输出单一可部署策略。实验验证了该方法在离散和连续控制任务上的有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Efficient exploration is a central problem in reinforcement learning and is often formalized as maximizing the entropy of the state-action occupancy measure. While unconstrained maximum-entropy exploration is relatively well understood, real-world exploration is often constrained by safety, resource, or imitation requirements. This constrained setting is particularly challenging because entropy maximization lacks additive structure, rendering Bellman-equation-based methods inapplicable. Moreover, scalable approaches require policy parameterization, inducing non-convexity in both the objective and the constraints. To our knowledge, the only prior model-free policy-gradient approach for this setting under general policy parameterization is due to Ying et al. (2025). Unfortunately, their guarantees are limited to weak regret and ergodic averages, which do not imply that the final output is a single deployable policy that is near-optimal and nearly feasible. In this work we take a different approach to this problem, and propose Policy Gradient Penalty (PGP) method, a single-loop policy-space method that enforces general convex occupancy-measure constraints via quadratic-penalty regularization. PGP constructs pseudo-rewards that yield gradient estimates of the penalized objective, subsequently exploiting the classical Policy Gradient Theorem. We further establish the regularity of the penalized objective, providing the smoothness properties needed to justify the convergence of PGP. Leveraging hidden convexity and strong duality, we then establish global last-iterate convergence guarantees, attaining an $ε$-optimal constrained entropy value with $ε$ bounded constraint violation despite policy-induced non-convexity. We validate PGP through ablations on a grid-world benchmark and further demonstrate scalability on two challenging continuous-control tasks.

</details>


### [324] [Explainable Load Forecasting with Covariate-Informed Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28149)
*Matthias Hertel,Alexandra Nikoltchovska,Sebastian Pütz,Ralf Mikut,Benjamin Schäfer,Veit Hagenmeyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出针对时间序列基础模型的高效SHAP解释算法，通过掩码策略实现可扩展解释，在输电系统运营商的日间负荷预测任务中验证了Chronos-2和TabPFN-TS的零样本性能，并证明解释结果符合领域知识，表明TSFM可作为透明可靠的能源预测工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSFM虽已展现出能源系统应用的潜力，但电力电网等关键基础设施需要模型透明性以确保信任和可靠性，纯黑盒模型难以满足这一要求。

Method: 利用TSFM对输入上下文长度和协变量的灵活性，设计高效的时间掩码和协变量掩码策略（选择性保留/遮蔽输入），实现可扩展的SHAP解释计算。对Chronos-2和TabPFN-TS两种TSFM进行零样本评估。

Result: 两种TSFM在零样本设置下达到与专项训练Transformer相当的预测性能；SHAP解释结果与领域知识一致，模型正确利用了天气和日历信息进行负荷预测。

Conclusion: TSFMs可作为透明且可靠的操作级能源预测工具，在保持竞争力的预测性能的同时，通过提出的SHAP框架实现模型可解释性。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have recently emerged as general-purpose forecasting models and show considerable potential for applications in energy systems. However, applications in critical infrastructure like power grids require transparency to ensure trust and reliability and cannot rely on pure black-box models. To enhance the transparency of TSFMs, we propose an efficient algorithm for computing Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) tailored to these models. The proposed approach leverages the flexibility of TSFMs with respect to input context length and provided covariates. This property enables efficient temporal and covariate masking (selectively withholding inputs), allowing for a scalable explanation of model predictions using SHAP. We evaluate two TSFMs - Chronos-2 and TabPFN-TS - on a day-ahead load forecasting task for a transmission system operator (TSO). In a zero-shot setting, both models achieve predictive performance competitive with a Transformer model trained specifically on multiple years of TSO data. The explanations obtained through our proposed approach align with established domain knowledge, particularly as the TSFMs appropriately use weather and calendar information for load prediction. Overall, we demonstrate that TSFMs can serve as transparent and reliable tools for operational energy forecasting.

</details>


### [325] [Strait: Perceiving Priority and Interference in ML Inference Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28175)
*Haidong Zhao,Nikolaos Georgantas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Strait is a serving system that enhances deadline satisfaction for dual-priority ML inference traffic by modeling contention and interference through adaptive prediction, performing priority-aware scheduling to deliver differentiated handling under high GPU utilization.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current ML inference serving systems have limited task prioritization support and insufficient latency estimation under concurrent execution, restricting their applicability in on-premises scenarios.

Method: Strait models data transfer contention and kernel execution interference through an adaptive prediction model, enabling priority-aware scheduling for differentiated request handling under high GPU utilization.

Result: Strait reduces deadline violations for high-priority tasks by 1.02 to 11.18 percentage points while incurring acceptable costs on low-priority tasks, demonstrating more equitable performance than software-defined preemption approaches.

Conclusion: Strait effectively delivers differentiated handling for dual-priority inference traffic with improved latency estimation and priority-aware scheduling, providing more equitable performance than software-defined preemption approaches.

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) inference serving systems host deep neural network (DNN) models and schedule incoming inference requests across deployed GPUs. However, limited support for task prioritization and insufficient latency estimation under concurrent execution may restrict their applicability in on-premises scenarios. We present \emph{Strait}, a serving system designed to enhance deadline satisfaction for dual-priority inference traffic under high GPU utilization. To improve latency estimation, Strait models potential contention during data transfer and accounts for kernel execution interference through an adaptive prediction model. By drawing on these predictions, it performs priority-aware scheduling to deliver differentiated handling. Evaluation results under intense workloads suggest that Strait reduces deadline violations for high-priority tasks by 1.02 to 11.18 percentage points while incurring acceptable costs on low-priority tasks. Compared to software-defined preemption approaches, Strait also exhibits more equitable performance.

</details>


### [326] [An adaptive wavelet-based PINN for problems with localized high-magnitude source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28180)
*Himanshu Pandey,Ratikanta Behera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对"局部高幅值源项"导致的极端损失失衡（最高达10^10:1）问题，本文提出自适应小波PINN（AW-PINN）：先用固定基的W-PINN短时预训练并按响应相似度筛选出物理相关的小波族，再把这些族参数化为可学习的尺度/平移（w_i、b_i）并用L-BFGS联合优化，导数全部解析求导（不依赖autograd）。在导热、局部Poisson、强振荡流动与Maxwell点电荷四类算例上，AW-PINN的相对L2误差比W-PINN/MMPINN低1–2个数量级，且训练时间远短于MMPINN、所需配点更少；理论上给出高斯过程极限与分解形式的NTK。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN存在两个根本缺陷：神经网络的谱偏置（优先学习低频分量）以及多尺度现象引起的损失失衡（损失项量级差异达10^10:1时，优化器只压主项、其余项被忽略）。局部高幅值源项问题（热处理/焊接、电磁传播、冲击力学、流体局部强迫、点电荷）在热传导、Poisson、强振荡流动与Maxwell方程中都会产生极端失衡。已有对策：SA-PINN（自适应用于各点的可训练权重）、MMPINN（对损失项取幂做量级正则 + 多级训练）、相对损失平衡 + random look-back等，它们都需要问题相关的手工超参/先验知识，且在极端失衡下仍需大量增加配点并伴随长时间训练。W-PINN虽在波形空间训练（平缓多尺度、免autograd），但需要为极高尺度在全域铺满小波基，基函数数量随尺度指数增长，波let矩阵内存开销大且优化高度非凸。

Method: 两阶段框架。阶段1（W-PINN预训练与族筛选）：按W-PINN构造多分辨率张量积小波基索引集I={j∈J_n, k∈K_n(j_n)}，用固定基与预计算系数训练；对每个族计算其诱导的残差响应向量R_i=P[c_iΨ_i]与边界响应B_i=B[c_iΨ_i]，用归一化相似度Score_i^R=<R_i,f>/|<R_i,f>|_max、Score_i^B=<B_i,g>/|<B_i,g>|_max（当右端恒为零时改用归一化响应均值），并结合top-κ大系数族筛选出活跃集I_A。阶段2（自适应精化）：把每个活跃族写成参数化小波单元W_i(x;θ_i)=∏_n ψ(w_{i,n}x_n+b_{i,n})，以w_i,n(0)=2^{j_i,n}、b_i,n(0)=-k_i,n初始化，尺度与平移在L-BFGS中连续自适应（仅在需要的高尺度区域加密，不全域铺满）；系数由预训练值初始化，最后一层线性层加可训练偏置B；损失仍为残差+监督项，但PDE算子所需导数由基函数解析求导给出，完全不用autograd。理论：定理3.1（Bias=0、N_A→∞时在有限维分布下收敛到零均值高斯过程Gp(0,k)，k(x,x')=σ_c²E_θ[W(x;θ)W(x';θ)]）；经验NTK可分解为K=K_c+K_θ，分别来自线性系数c_i与自适应参数θ_i。实验用高斯波let（一阶导）、Xavier初始化，ADAM预训练+L-BFGS精化，指标为全域均匀测试点上的相对L2误差，每例重复5–10次取均值。

Result: （1）热传导极端热源（ε=0.12/0.11/0.10，初始损失比L_b:L_i:L_r=1:10:10^9）：baseline PINN误差8.1e-1~9.6e-1；AW-PINN误差3.52e-6/8.15e-6/8.86e-6，比W-PINN（3.1e-5~4.1e-5）和MMPINN（1.71e-5~2.44e-5，ε=0.10时失效至8.46e-1）低1–2个数量级；训练约24–25 min，远短于MMPINN的91–208 min，且无需像MMPINN那样随ε减小增加配点。（2）二维局部Poisson（ε=0.05/0.02，损失比10^4:10^11）：AW-PINN 3.42e-5/2.68e-4，优于W-PINN（3.55e-4/9.81e-3）与MMPINN（5.71e-4/3.25e-3）；尺度自适应曲线显示只在源附近提升分辨率，优于W-PINN的"全域高分辨率基"策略。（3）强振荡流动方程（A=100, T_s=0.05）：AW-PINN 5.17e-4，优于W-PINN 1.27e-2与MMPINN 8.35e-2；误差曲线非振荡、收敛更快。（4）Maxwell TEz点电荷（高斯脉冲源，FDTD参考）：AW-PINN在E_x/E_y/H_z上分别为5.31e-3/6.54e-3/9.01e-3，而W-PINN为8.52e-2/8.94e-2/4.52e-1、MMPINN为4.33e-2/3.91e-2/2.31e-1，后两者均不能满意求解；AW-PINN训练76.57 min（vs MMPINN 182.16 min）。总体上AW-PINN在全部算例、全部指标上以更少配点、较短训练时间取得最低误差。

Conclusion: AW-PINN通过把W-PINN的固定小波族升级为可自适应尺度与平移的参数化小波单元，配合基于残差/监督响应的族筛选与解析导数，能在不增加大量配点、不内存密集的前提下有效应对局部高幅值源项造成的极端损失失衡，精度一致优于W-PINN与MMPINN，并具备高斯过程极限与可分解NTK的理论刻画。局限与展望：基于相似度的基族筛选仍含人工调参（阈值IC/BC/PDE、top-κ%）且依赖预训练质量，需要更自动化的选择机制；仅使用了高斯波let，其他波let基族的系统比较有待开展；需在更广泛的多尺度问题类别上评估其通用性。

Abstract: In recent years, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have gained significant attention for solving differential equations, although they suffer from two fundamental limitations, namely, spectral bias inherent in neural networks and loss imbalance arising from multiscale phenomena. This paper proposes an adaptive wavelet-based PINN (AW-PINN) to address the extreme loss imbalance characteristic of problems with localized high-magnitude source terms. Such problems frequently arise in various physical applications, such as thermal processing, electro-magnetics, impact mechanics, and fluid dynamics involving localized forcing. The proposed framework dynamically adjusts the wavelet basis function based on residual and supervised loss. This adaptive nature makes AW-PINN handle problems with high-scale features effectively without being memory-intensive. Additionally, AW-PINN does not rely on automatic differentiation to obtain derivatives involved in the loss function, which accelerates the training process. The method operates in two stages, an initial short pre-training phase with fixed bases to select physically relevant wavelet families, followed by an adaptive refinement that adapts scales and translations without populating high-resolution bases across entire domains. Theoretically, we show that under certain assumptions, AW-PINN admits a Gaussian process limit and derive its associated NTK structure. We evaluate AW-PINN on several challenging PDEs featuring localized high-magnitude source terms with extreme loss imbalances having ratios up to $10^{10}:1$. Across these PDEs, including transient heat conduction, highly localized Poisson problems, oscillatory flow equations, and Maxwell equations with a point charge source, AW-PINN consistently outperforms existing methods in its class.

</details>

### [327] [MARS: Efficient, Adaptive Co-Scheduling for Heterogeneous Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26963)
*Yifei Wang,Hancheng Ye,Yechen Xu,Cong Guo,Chiyue Wei,Qinsi Wang,Dongting Li,Tingjun Chen,Hai "Helen" Li,Danyang Zhuo,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: MARS是一个高效自适应的协同调度系统，通过统一信息流和双层调度机制协调智能体执行中的GPU-CPU异构资源，实现端到端延迟降低5.94倍，已集成至OpenHands框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正从独立文本生成器转变为自主智能体的执行核心。智能体工作负载带来时间维度的单轮到多轮推理转变，以及空间维度的聊天规模纯GPU到仓库规模GPU-CPU协同执行的转变。如何协调智能体执行中异构资源的需求成为关键系统挑战。

Method: 设计了MARS系统，通过统一信息流实现GPU推理与CPU工具执行的全局可视性。外部控制平面将准入控制与执行解耦，防止资源过载；内部智能体调度器通过优先处理延迟敏感任务、自适应保留KV缓存（仅在热启动有收益时）来最小化关键路径延迟。

Result: 端到端延迟降低最高5.94倍，同时保持近最大系统吞吐量。集成至OpenHands代码智能体框架后，任务完成时间加速最高1.87倍。

Conclusion: MARS通过统一的资源协调机制有效解决了LLM智能体工作负载中的GPU-CPU异构资源协调问题，显著降低延迟并提升吞吐量，已集成至OpenHands代码智能体框架，代码即将开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as the execution core of autonomous agents rather than as standalone text generators. Agentic workloads induce a temporal shift from single-turn inference to multi-turn LLM-tool loops, and a spatial shift from chat-scale, GPU-only execution to repository-scale, GPU-CPU co-located execution. Consequently, coordinating heterogeneous resource demands of agentic execution has emerged as a critical system challenge.
  We design and implement MARS, an efficient and adaptive co-scheduling system that globally coordinates heterogeneous agentic workloads under coupled GPU-CPU resource pressure. By establishing holistic visibility across GPU inference and CPU tool execution via a unified information stream, an external control plane in MARS decouples admission from execution to prevent heterogeneous resource oversubscription. An internal agent-centric scheduler further minimizes the end-to-end critical path by prioritizing latency-sensitive continuations and adaptively retaining KV cache state only when warm resumption yields a latency benefit. Our evaluations show that MARS reduces end-to-end latency by up to 5.94x while maintaining nearly maximal system throughput. We further integrate MARS as the serving backend for the OpenHands coding agent framework, demonstrating its real-world effectiveness by accelerating end-to-end task completion time by up to 1.87x.
  Our source code will be publicly available soon.

</details>


### [328] [Affinity Tailor: Dynamic Locality-Aware Scheduling at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27915)
*Jin Xin Ng,Ori Livneh,Richard O'Grady,Josh Don,Peng Ding,Samuel Grossman,Luis Otero,Chris Kennelly,David Lo,Carlos Villavieja*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: Affinity Tailor通过将拓扑紧凑的需求规模CPU集合作为软亲和性约束，在保持系统利用率的同时显著提升工作负载局部性，在Google生产环境中实现显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代多核系统中，多个工作负载共享CPU调度导致工作负载散布在多个核心上执行，削弱了微架构层面的局部性（缓存、分支预测器、预取器），并造成相互干扰。在基于chiplet的系统中，跨核心调度还导致跨LLC边界，影响性能。

Method: 用户空间引导的内核调度系统，将需求规模的、拓扑紧凑的CPU集合作为亲和性提示而非硬分区。控制其估算工作负载的CPU需求并分配合适的CPU集合，尽量与其他工作负载保持互斥，同时跨越尽可能少的LLC域。

Result: 在Google部署后，基于chiplet的系统上每CPU吞吐量几何平均提升12%，非chiplet系统提升3%；更快的执行减少了内存驻留，实现每GB吞吐量提升3-7%。

Conclusion: 未来调度器应将空间局部性作为一等目标，即使以牺牲工作守恒原则为代价。Affinity Tailor已部署于Google，在chiplet系统上实现12%吞吐量提升，非chiplet系统提升3%。

Abstract: Modern large multicore systems often run multiple workloads that share CPUs under schedulers such as Linux CFS. To keep CPUs busy, these schedulers load-balance runnable work, causing each workload to execute on many cores. This weakens locality at the microarchitectural level: workloads lose reuse in caches, branch predictors, and prefetchers, and interfere more with one another - especially on chiplet-based systems, where spreading execution across cores also spreads it across LLC boundaries. A natural alternative is strict CPU partitioning, but hard partitions leave capacity idle when workloads do not fully use their reserved CPUs.
  We present Affinity Tailor, a userspace-guided kernel scheduling system built on a key insight: the kernel can preserve locality for workloads that share CPUs by treating demand-sized, topologically compact CPU sets as affinity hints rather than hard partitions. A userspace controller estimates each workload's CPU demand online and assigns a preferred CPU set sized to that demand, chosen to be as disjoint as possible from other workloads while spanning as few LLC domains as possible. The kernel then uses this set as an affinity hint, steering threads toward those CPUs while still allowing execution elsewhere when needed to preserve utilization. Deployed at Google, Affinity Tailor delivers geometric-mean per-CPU throughput gains of 12% on chiplet-based systems and 3% on non-chiplet systems over Linux CFS. Furthermore, faster execution reduces memory residency, yielding per-GB throughput gains of 3-7%. Our findings suggest that future schedulers should treat spatial locality as a first-class objective, even at the expense of work-conservation.

</details>


### [329] [Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28138)
*Tianyuan Wu,Chaokun Chang,Lunxi Cao,Wei Gao,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: Crab 是一个面向智能体沙箱的语义感知检查点/恢复（C/R）运行时，通过在主机侧观察智能体每轮在操作系统层可见的副作用，判定该轮是否需要检查点以及需要何种粒度，从而在不修改智能体框架与 C/R 后端的前提下，把轻量级恢复的正确性从 8% 提升到 100%，同时把检查点流量削减最多 87%，端到端时间仅比无故障执行慢 1.9% 以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体在容器/微虚拟机沙箱中执行 shell 命令、装包、改文件、起后台进程，其真实状态横跨对话历史与内核可见状态（文件系统、进程、内存）。现有方案陷入两个极端：应用层恢复（Claude Code rewind、LangGraph 持久化）廉价但只恢复聊天/文件状态，丢失已装包、常驻进程等 OS 副作用，恢复后环境不一致；OS/VM 层方案（Docker、E2B/Firecracker、CRIU）正确但把每一步都当作有状态，在高密度共置下代价过高（E2B 快照需暂停 microVM，开销 >4 s）。作者指出根因是"智能体–OS 语义鸿沟"：智能体框架只看到工具调用而看不到其 OS 效应，OS 只看到状态变更而缺少轮次上下文来判定恢复相关性；且该鸿沟掩盖了巨大的稀疏性——超过 75% 的轮次不产生任何与恢复相关的状态，因此多数检查点是多余的。工具 API 层无法弥合此鸿沟：run_shell_command 占 60.4% 的工具调用，命令空间无界，12,483 条 shell 命令中仅 5.3% 含重定向、1.0% 后台执行、16.2% 使用管道。

Method: 系统要求 R1 恢复正确性、R2 低暴露开销、R3 高密度共置可扩展。三组件：① Coordinator（用户态 HTTP 反向代理，位于智能体–LLM 路径），通过拦截出站请求识别轮次边界、在请求转发后立即派发异步检查点、缓存返回响应并在检查点未完成时阻塞释放（completion gating）、在 LLM 响应先返回时将作业升级为高优先级（urgency signaling）；② Inspector（eBPF 内核监控 + 用户态守护进程），采用"net-change"语义只报告持续性变化：文件系统用 sys_enter/sys_exit 原始 tracepoint 按文件粒度跟踪，进程用 cgroup 成员变化 + /proc/PID/pagemap 软脏位与 clear_refs 检测存活进程内存写入；输出 none / filesystem-only / process-only / full 四类判定；③ C/R Engine（数据面）：Scheduler 用 normal/high-priority 双 FIFO 的反应式调度，Workers 用 runc+CRIU（进程）、OpenZFS 快照（文件系统）、ZFS rollback + CRIU load（恢复），Manager 用版本化清单 C_i=(P_j,F_k) 组合部分产物并以 pending→dumping→versioning→done 生命周期实现事务化发布，失败则标记 failed 不作为恢复点。部署细化：agent-with-a-sandbox 下由 Coordinator 记录并重发未完成命令以实现可靠执行接口；agent-in-a-sandbox 下把智能体自身进程排除在进程状态跟踪之外以免每轮都需进程检查点，并用 fast-forward（缓存请求-响应对、重放时返回合成响应）修复恢复后智能体内存状态滞后于文件系统的不一致。

Result: 在 SWE-Bench 与 Terminal-Bench 上（Claude-code/iFlow-cli/SWE-agent，AWS c6id.32xlarge 128 核，密度 16–96）：崩溃恢复正确性 100%，而 chat-only 仅 8–13%（Terminal-Bench）、9%（SWE-Bench），chat+FS 为 28%/42%（Terminal-Bench）；相比 Restart（最高 1.52×/1.67× 慢）和每轮全量检查点（Terminal-Bench 密度 96 时 3.78× 慢，源于主机 I/O 争用），Crab 与无故障执行差距在 0–1.9% 以内。稀疏性：最高 87% 轮次被完全跳过；Inspector 在 2,063 个人工标注轮次上进程变化检测 100% 准确、零漏检，文件系统 98.3% 准确（2.3% 假阳性，源于保守的按文件跟踪）。组件开销：Coordinator 每轮中位 18/16 µs、p95 40/27 µs（<0.02%）；Inspector 中位 31–72 ms、p95 <200 ms，多被 LLM 等待窗口掩盖；检查点延迟双峰（20–100 ms 文件系统、700–1000 ms 进程），p50/p95/p99 = 0.1/0.7/1.0 s；异步机制下暴露延迟中位为 0，p95 在密度 16/32/64/96 时为 0.00%/0.37%/0.44%/3.65%；反应式调度相对 FIFO 将暴露延迟中位最多降低 41.6%、p95 最多降低 31.3%。案例：将 rollback 作为工具暴露给智能体后，QEMU 启动任务 434 s→307 s（-29%），金融文档分类回滚 token -36%；推测执行使 SWE-Bench 中位任务时间 224.1→206.5 s（-7.9%），误推测惩罚中位 2.2 s（0.9%），58.0% 的 fork 复用上一轮 fork；Spot 场景 C/R 中位/p95 为 0.71/1.00 s，1–5 次抢占下仅增加 0.45–3.01% 中位、1.01–7.30% p95 时间；树状 RL 分支 1–5 时 rollout token 降低 40.0–64.2%。

Conclusion: Crab 通过把智能体当作黑盒、在轮次边界观察 OS 可见副作用来推断检查点粒度，并将检查点工作与 LLM 等待窗口重叠、在主机范围调度，成功弥合智能体–OS 语义鸿沟：恢复正确性从 8% 提升到 100%，检查点流量削减最多 87%，时间开销控制在无故障执行的 1.9% 以内，并在 96 沙箱共置下依然成立。更广泛的启示是：不透明工作负载的 OS 可见效应可作为轻量语义信号，用于自适应状态管理，该原则可推广到调度、资源隔离与安全审计。作者同时给出工具层无法弥合鸿沟的证据，并说明未修改智能体与 C/R 后端的透明性设计。

Abstract: Autonomous agents act through sandboxed containers and microVMs whose state spans filesystems, processes, and runtime artifacts. Checkpoint and restore (C/R) of this state is needed for fault tolerance, spot execution, RL rollout branching, and safe rollback-yet existing approaches fall into two extremes: application-level recovery preserves chat history but misses OS-side effects, while full per-turn checkpointing is correct but too expensive under dense co-location. The root cause is an agent-OS semantic gap: agent frameworks see tool calls but not their OS effects; the OS sees state changes but lacks turn-level context to judge recovery relevance. This gap hides massive sparsity: over 75% of agent turns produce no recovery-relevant state, so most checkpoints are unnecessary. Crab (Checkpoint-and-Restore for Agent SandBoxes) is a transparent host-side runtime that bridges this gap without modifying agents or C/R backends. An eBPF-based inspector classifies each turn's OS-visible effects to decide checkpoint granularity; a coordinator aligns checkpoints with turn boundaries and overlaps C/R with LLM wait time; and a host-scoped engine schedules checkpoint traffic across co-located sandboxes. On shell-intensive and code-repair workloads, Crab raises recovery correctness from 8% (chat-only) to 100%, cuts checkpoint traffic by up to 87%, and stays within 1.9% of fault-free execution time.

</details>
